location: 頭頂部，以百會穴（GV20）為中心，前、後、左、右各1寸，共4個穴位。
locationEn: A group of four points at the vertex, located 1 cun anterior, posterior, and to each side of Baihui (GV20).
techniqueNotes:
課件與 eLotus：皮下刺0.5~1.0寸；課件另強調四針均朝中心。American Dragon：皮下刺0.5~1.0寸，另列斜刺0.5~1.0寸或橫刺0.5~1.5寸；可將四穴成組針刺，或由百會透刺。eLotus 與 AD 均記艾灸適用。
Curriculum and eLotus: subcutaneous insertion 0.5-1.0 cun; the curriculum additionally directs all needles toward the center. American Dragon: subcutaneous 0.5-1.0 cun, with additional slanted 0.5-1.0 cun or transverse 0.5-1.5 cun methods; the four points may be needled as a group or through-needled from Baihui. eLotus and AD state that moxibustion is applicable.
functions: 安神，平肝，熄內風，明目聰耳
functionsEn: Calms the Shen; Pacifies the Liver; Subdues Interior Wind; Benefits the Eyes and Ears
patterns: 神經衰弱（AD 歷史用語）
cautions: 課件、eLotus 與 American Dragon 均未列四神聰穴位專屬禁忌；不可把來源沉默解讀為無風險。課件／eLotus 的皮下刺0.5~1.0寸及朝中心取向，與 AD 另列的橫刺0.5~1.5寸、四穴成組或由百會透刺並非完全相同；須由持照針灸師依頭皮解剖與所受訓練選擇，不得合併成單一標準。原卡『顱骨未閉合嬰幼兒慎用』予以保留，但本輪四來源未找到直接支持，故標為尚待兒科／解剖來源核實。
evidence: 四來源整合：NCBAHM Appendix A 確認考試範圍；課件提供四穴環繞百會、針尖朝中心、安神平肝及五項核心主治；eLotus 補安神、熄風、皮下刺與可灸；American Dragon 補明目聰耳、更多主治、不同針法版本與成組／百會透刺註記。WHO 國際命名文件僅作代碼依據：本庫主碼 EX-HN1，課件與 AD 的 M-HN-1 作來源別碼。Actions、Indications 與未證實安全敘述分層保留。

location: 眉間區，兩眉內側端連線的中點，即眉間（glabella）中央。
locationEn: At the glabella, on the midline at the midpoint between the medial ends of the eyebrows.
techniqueNotes:
課件：提皮，向下斜刺或皮下刺0.3~0.5寸。eLotus：皮下刺0.3~0.5寸，艾灸適用。American Dragon：一組版本為提皮後向下或側方橫刺0.3~0.5寸；另列向下或向攢竹（BL2）／睛明（BL1）方向0.5~1寸，可能出現局部脹痠並延至鼻尖；記艾灸適用。既有三稜針點刺出血法保留，但本輪三個內容來源未列，故不得視為四來源共識。
Curriculum: pinch the skin and insert obliquely downward or subcutaneously 0.3-0.5 cun. eLotus: subcutaneous insertion 0.3-0.5 cun; moxibustion is applicable. American Dragon: one version uses a pinched-skin transverse insertion inferiorly or laterally 0.3-0.5 cun; another directs the needle inferiorly or toward Zanzhu (BL2)/Jingming (BL1), 0.5-1 cun, with possible local distention and soreness extending to the tip of the nose; moxibustion is applicable. The legacy three-edged-needle bleeding method is retained, but none of the three content sources reviewed lists it, so it is not treated as four-source consensus.
functions: 安神定志，疏風清熱，通鼻開竅，熄風止痙，通絡止痛
functionsEn: Calms the Shen; Dispels Wind and clears Heat; Opens the nose; Pacifies Wind and stops convulsions; Activates the channel and alleviates pain
patterns: 妊娠期抽搐（AD 列為主治；非安全許可）
產後血虛昏厥／暈眩（AD 原頁表述）
酒後頭風（AD 配穴表述）
patternsEn: Convulsions during pregnancy (listed by AD as an indication, not safety clearance)
Postpartum fainting/dizziness associated with Blood loss (AD wording)
Head Wind following intoxication (AD combination-table wording)
cautions: 課件、eLotus 與 American Dragon 均未列印堂穴位專屬禁忌；不可把來源沉默解讀為無風險。AD 同時列0.3~0.5寸與0.5~1寸、並有朝 BL2／BL1 方向的版本，深度和方向不得合併為單一標準。AD 將『妊娠期抽搐』列在主治中，這不是孕期針刺安全許可；本輪來源未提供孕婦專屬操作注意。既有三稜針點刺出血法未獲課件、eLotus 或 AD 本頁支持，僅保留待另源核實。既有『已歸入 GV／督脈』屬命名分類問題，移至穴位身分註記，不作臨床禁忌。
evidence: 四來源整合：NCBAHM Appendix A 確認考試範圍；課件提供 M-HN-3 身分、眉間定位、提皮向下／皮下刺0.3~0.5寸及核心主治；eLotus 補安神熄風、通鼻止痛、0.3~0.5寸與可灸；American Dragon 補多層功效、完整主治、配穴、0.3~0.5與0.5~1寸不同技法及別名。既有鼻淵、三稜針出血與 GV／督脈註記均保留，但分別標出來源狀態，不混入已核實共識。

needling: 課件：提皮向下斜刺或皮下刺0.3~0.5寸。eLotus：皮下刺0.3~0.5寸。AD：提皮後向下／側方橫刺0.3~0.5寸；另列向下或朝 BL2／BL1 方向0.5~1寸。深度與方向有來源差異，分列而不合併。既有三稜針點刺出血法待另源核實。
needlingEn: Curriculum: pinch the skin and insert obliquely downward or subcutaneously 0.3-0.5 cun. eLotus: subcutaneous insertion 0.3-0.5 cun. AD: pinched-skin transverse insertion inferiorly/laterally 0.3-0.5 cun, plus a separate 0.5-1-cun variant directed inferiorly or toward BL2/BL1. The depth and direction variants are kept separate rather than merged. The legacy three-edged-needle bleeding method awaits another source.
cautionsEn: The curriculum, eLotus, and American Dragon list no point-specific contraindication for Yintang; source silence must not be interpreted as absence of risk.
AD lists both 0.3-0.5-cun and 0.5-1-cun methods, including directions toward BL2/BL1. These depth and direction variants must not be merged into a single standard.
AD lists convulsions during pregnancy under indications; this is not pregnancy needling clearance. The sources reviewed provide no pregnancy-specific technique caution.
The legacy three-edged-needle bleeding method is retained pending another source because it is not supported by the curriculum, eLotus, or AD Yintang entries reviewed here.
The legacy statement that Yintang has been incorporated into the GV/Du channel is a nomenclature issue, not a clinical contraindication, and is recorded under point identity.
cunMeasurement: 不以寸量為主；以兩眉內側端的連線中點與眉間正中線定位。
anatomyZh: 位於眉間正中線的皮膚與皮下組織區。Board Outline、課件、eLotus 與 American Dragon 均未提供逐層神經血管解剖；AD 所列向攢竹（BL2）或睛明（BL1）方向的透刺版本只作技法差異保留，不據此推定安全層次。
anatomyEn: The point lies in the skin and subcutaneous tissues of the glabellar midline. The Board Outline, curriculum, eLotus, and American Dragon do not provide layer-by-layer neurovascular anatomy. AD's variants directed toward Zanzhu (BL2) or Jingming (BL1) are retained only as technique variants and are not used to infer a safe anatomical plane.
acumethodZh: 課件：提皮向下斜刺或皮下刺0.3~0.5寸。eLotus：皮下刺0.3~0.5寸。AD：提皮後向下／側方橫刺0.3~0.5寸；另列向下或朝 BL2／BL1 方向0.5~1寸。深度與方向有來源差異，分列而不合併。既有三稜針點刺出血法待另源核實。

location: 正視時，瞳孔直上，眉毛正中點的凹陷處。AD 補充傳統位置在眶上切跡外側。
locationEn: With the eyes looking straight ahead, in the depression at the midpoint of the eyebrow directly above the pupil. AD adds that the traditional location lies lateral to the supraorbital notch.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus／AD 共同基線：皮下刺0.3~0.5寸。課件：沿眉毛平行、輕柔進針，皮下刺0.5~1寸；可由攢竹（BL2）透向魚腰，並提示本穴敏感疼痛。AD 另列向內或向外橫刺0.5~1寸，可透向 BL2 或絲竹空（TE23），針感可延至眼球；亦記可由陽白（GB14）或 BL2 透刺刺激魚腰。既有三稜針點刺出血與禁灸記載在本輪三個內容來源均未找到，予以保留但不視為共識。
eLotus/AD shared baseline: subcutaneous insertion 0.3-0.5 cun. Curriculum: gentle subcutaneous insertion parallel to the eyebrow, 0.5-1 cun; Zanzhu (BL2) may be directed toward Yuyao, and the point is described as sensitive and painful. AD additionally lists medial or lateral transverse insertion 0.5-1 cun, including joining BL2 or Sizhukong (TE23), with sensation possibly extending to the eyeball; stimulation by through-needling from Yangbai (GB14) or BL2 is also noted. The legacy three-edged-needle bleeding and moxa-prohibition statements were not found in the three content sources and are retained without consensus status.
functions: 疏風清熱，明目退翳，舒筋通絡，止痛
functionsEn: Dispels Wind and clears Heat; Benefits the eyes and removes visual obstruction; Relaxes the sinews and opens the channel; Relieves pain
patterns: 角膜混濁／淺表視覺障礙
cautions: 課件提示魚腰非常敏感、可能疼痛，要求沿眉平行並輕柔進針；AD 指出眶上神經由附近眶上切跡穿出，且橫刺針感可延至眼球。三個內容來源均未列正式穴位禁忌，因此不可把來源沉默解讀為無風險。0.3~0.5寸基線與0.5~1寸橫刺／透刺版本不得合併，較長透刺須由具備眼眶周圍解剖與相應技法訓練的持照針灸師執行。既有『不宜直刺過深』『禁灸』及三稜針放血均保留，但本輪未找到直接來源支持。
evidence: 四來源整合：NCBAHM Appendix A 確認範圍；課件 p.9 提供 M-HN-6、定位、沿眉輕柔0.5~1寸與眼病主治；eLotus 提供 EX-HN4、0.3~0.5寸基線、明目舒筋止痛與主治；AD 補眶上切跡／眶上神經提示、0.5~1寸橫刺／透刺版本、清熱通絡、完整主治與配穴。既有疏風退翳、放血、禁灸與深刺警語不刪除，但明確標示未獲本輪四來源直接支持。
combinePointsZh:

【眶上神經痛；AD】魚腰配攢竹（BL2）、四瀆（TE9）、內關（PC6）。
【白內障；AD】魚腰配瞳子髎（GB1）、攢竹（BL2）、睛明（BL1）。
【既有學習配伍；部分獲 AD 技法支持】眼瞼下垂：魚腰配攢竹（BL2）、陽白（GB14）；AD 記可由 BL2 或 GB14 透刺魚腰，但未把此組明列為眼瞼下垂配方。

cautionsEn: The curriculum describes Yuyao as very sensitive and potentially painful, directing gentle insertion parallel to the eyebrow. AD identifies the nearby supraorbital nerve exit and notes that transverse needling sensation may extend to the eyeball.
The three content sources list no formal point-specific contraindication; source silence must not be interpreted as absence of risk.

The 0.3-0.5-cun baseline must not be merged with the 0.5-1-cun transverse/through-needling variants. Longer through-needling requires a licensed acupuncturist trained in peri-orbital anatomy and the specific technique.
The legacy cautions against deep perpendicular needling and moxibustion, plus the legacy three-edged-needle bleeding method, are retained but were not directly supported by the sources reviewed.

anatomyEn: The point lies superficially over the brow and superior orbital rim. American Dragon notes that the traditional location is lateral to the supraorbital notch, where the supraorbital nerve emerges; the other three source layers provide no layer-by-layer anatomy. This identifies a local sensitive structure but is not used to infer a deeper safe depth.

location: 顳部，眉梢與外眼角連線中點向後約1寸（約一橫指）的凹陷處，常可觸及壓痛。
locationEn: In the temporal region, in the often-tender depression about 1 cun (approximately one finger breadth) posterior to the midpoint between the lateral end of the eyebrow and the outer canthus.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus／AD 共同基線：直刺0.3~0.5寸，或點刺出血；AD 指急性結膜炎或頭痛可刺出數滴血。課件另列直刺0.5~1寸、斜刺／皮下刺1~2寸，要求避開血管、輕柔進針。AD 還列直刺0.5~1寸或0.5~0.8寸、向後透率谷（GB8）0.5~1.5寸或1~2寸、向前斜刺0.3~0.5寸，以及向下透頰車（ST6）3寸。這些不是單一共識，長距離透刺只作來源別進階技法記錄。
eLotus/AD shared baseline: perpendicular insertion 0.3-0.5 cun or prick to bleed; AD specifies a few drops of Blood for acute conjunctivitis or headache. The curriculum additionally lists perpendicular insertion 0.5-1 cun and oblique/subcutaneous insertion 1-2 cun, with gentle insertion and avoidance of the vein. AD also lists perpendicular 0.5-1 or 0.5-0.8 cun, posterior through-needling toward Shuaigu (GB8) 0.5-1.5 or 1-2 cun, anterior oblique insertion 0.3-0.5 cun, and inferior through-needling toward Jiache (ST6) 3 cun. These are not a single consensus; long through-needling is retained only as source-specific advanced technique.
functions: 袪風清熱，清頭明目，消腫，通絡止痛，醒腦
functionsEn: Dispels Wind and clears Heat; Clears the head and benefits the eyes; Reduces swelling; Activates the channel and alleviates pain; Clears the brain
patterns: 陽亢型高血壓（AD 表述）

patternsEn: Hypertension due to Yang Excess (AD wording)

evidence: 四來源整合：NCBAHM Appendix A 確認範圍；課件 p.9 提供 M-HN-9、定位、袪風清熱消腫止痛、0.5~1與1~2寸技法及避血管警語；eLotus 提供 EX-HN5、0.3~0.5寸／點刺放血共同基線、清頭明目與核心主治；AD 補多種來源別透刺、完整功效主治、配穴及常用局部穴註記。既有醒腦與止血警語不刪除，但分別標示未直接列為功效／未提供程序。

eLotus and AD list prick-to-bleed, and AD specifies a few drops for acute conjunctivitis or headache. The three content sources give no hemostasis protocol, so the legacy 'attend to hemostasis' warning is retained without invented steps.

AD's 0.5-1.5/1-2-cun through-needling toward GB8 and 3-cun through-needling toward ST6 differ substantially from the shared 0.3-0.5-cun baseline. They are limited to licensed acupuncturists formally trained in temporal anatomy and those techniques.
AD's martial-arts fatal-point note is a danger signal, not usable depth guidance.
The sources reviewed give no point-specific pregnancy, pediatric, or anticoagulation rules; none are guessed.

location: 眶下緣，外側1/4與內側3/4交界處。
locationEn: On the inferior orbital margin, at the junction of the lateral one-quarter and medial three-quarters.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus：輕推眼球向上，沿眶緣緩慢直刺0.5~1.2寸；禁止提插、捻轉。AD：一法令患者閉眼向上看，在眼球與眶下壁之間先略向下再直刺0.5~1寸；另一法固定眼球後略向內上方、朝視神經方向緩慢直刺1~1.5寸，並警告不可過深以免進入顱腔。AD 要求慢進針、不得提插捻轉，出針後立即以棉球在針孔處牢固按壓約1分鐘防血腫，且僅限有適當臨床經驗者。舊卡『出針壓迫眼球』改正為按壓針孔，不壓眼球。
eLotus: gently displace the eyeball upward and slowly insert perpendicularly 0.5-1.2 cun along the orbital margin; lifting, thrusting, twisting, and rotating are contraindicated. AD: one method has the patient close the eyes and look upward, inserting first slightly inferiorly then perpendicularly 0.5-1 cun between the globe and inferior orbital wall; another stabilizes the globe and slowly inserts slightly medially and upward toward the optic nerve 1-1.5 cun, warning against excessive depth because of possible cranial entry. AD requires slow insertion without manipulation, immediate firm cotton-ball pressure over the needle site for about one minute after withdrawal to prevent hematoma, and appropriate clinical experience. The legacy instruction to 'press the eyeball' after withdrawal is corrected to pressure over the needle site, not the globe.
functions: 明目，清熱退翳，活血通竅
functionsEn: Benefits the eyes; Clears Heat and removes visual obstruction; Invigorates Blood and opens the orifices

cautions: 高風險眼眶穴。eLotus 明列禁提插、捻轉；AD 要求慢進針、不得提插捻轉，並警告過深可能進入顱腔。AD 明確表示本法只應由具適當臨床經驗者嘗試。出針後應立即用棉球牢固按壓針孔約1分鐘以防血腫；舊卡『按壓1~2分鐘防出血』保留為時長差異，但『壓迫眼球』已校正為按壓針孔。eLotus 與 AD 未談艾灸，故既有禁灸僅作待核實警語。來源未提供孕婦、兒童、抗凝用藥或出血性疾病的專屬規則，不猜。
evidence: 四層查核：NCBAHM Appendix A 與現有課件均未找到球後專條；eLotus 提供 EX-HN7、定位、0.5~1.2寸、禁提插捻轉、明目與廣義眼病主治；AD 補 M-HN-8、0.5~1及1~1.5寸眶內版本、不可過深／防顱腔穿入、棉球壓針孔防血腫、僅限有經驗者、完整眼病主治與配穴。既有清熱退翳活血通竅、早期白內障與禁灸不刪除，但標為本輪未直接支持。

locationEn: On the face at the upper end of the nasolabial groove in the depression below the nasal bone; eLotus places it approximately 0.5 cun superior and medial to Yingxiang (LI20). AD lists transverse insertion toward the nose 0.5-0.8 cun, transverse insertion toward the bridge 0.3-0.5 cun, or subcutaneous upward insertion 0.3-0.5 cun. The sources differ in depth and direction; the variants are retained rather than merged into a false consensus.

needling: 課件：直刺0.2~0.3寸，或皮下向鼻根方向透刺。eLotus：向上斜刺／皮下0.3~0.5寸。AD：向鼻部橫刺0.5~0.8寸、向鼻樑橫刺0.3~0.5寸，或向上皮下0.3~0.5寸。
needlingEn: Course: perpendicular 0.2-0.3 cun or subcutaneous toward the nasal root. eLotus: oblique upward/subcutaneous 0.3-0.5 cun. AD: transverse toward the nose 0.5-0.8 cun, transverse toward the bridge 0.3-0.5 cun, or subcutaneous upward 0.3-0.5 cun.
cautions: 課件、eLotus 與 AD 的進針方向及深度不同：課件0.2~0.3寸或向鼻根皮下透刺；eLotus 向上0.3~0.5寸；AD 另列向鼻部0.5~0.8寸及向鼻樑0.3~0.5寸。不得把最大深度與其他來源方向任意拼接。四來源未提供逐層鼻旁神經血管圖譜，也未列本穴特定禁忌、孕婦、兒童、抗凝或出血性疾病規則；既有『鼻旁血管神經較密、避免深刺或向眼眶方向、鼻衄／鼻息肉／局部感染先評估』保留為解剖與程序性風險提示，但不冒充來源原文或完整安全規範。eLotus 的艾灸5~10分鐘為單一來源。
cautionsEn: Course, eLotus, and AD differ in direction and depth: the course gives 0.2-0.3 cun or subcutaneous toward the nasal root; eLotus gives 0.3-0.5 cun upward; AD additionally gives 0.5-0.8 cun toward the nose and 0.3-0.5 cun toward the bridge. Do not combine the greatest depth from one source with a direction from another.
The four sources provide no layer-by-layer paranasal neurovascular map and no point-specific contraindication, pregnancy, pediatric, anticoagulant, or bleeding-disorder rule.

The legacy cautions about dense facial vessels and nerves, avoiding deep/orbital direction, and assessing epistaxis, nasal polyps, or local infection are retained as anatomical/procedural risk notes, not as quoted source rules or a complete safety protocol.
The eLotus moxa duration of 5-10 minutes is a single-source value.

anatomyEn: This is a paranasal facial region at the upper end of the nasolabial groove below the nasal bone. The four sources do not provide layer-by-layer neurovascular anatomy or an orbital safety boundary; a deeper safe path must not be inferred from surface landmarks.

exam_pearl_en: Shangyingxiang is also Bitong. Know both the nomenclature difference—EX-HN8 in eLotus/database versus M-HN-14 in the course/AD—and the source-specific needling variants rather than memorizing a fabricated single depth.
combinePointsEn:
Allergic rhinitis / nasal obstruction (legacy card): Shangyingxiang with Yingxiang (LI20) and Hegu (LI4) opens the nasal passages locally and dispels Wind distally.
Chronic rhinitis (AD): Bitong with Shangxing (GV23), Yintang (EX-HN3), and Hegu (LI4); AD's table also displays Hegu (LI4), Shangxing (GV23), and Zanzhu (BL2), but the grouping is somewhat ambiguous because of page formatting.
Nasosinusitis (AD): Bitong with Zanzhu (BL2) and Lieque (LU7).
Chronic rhinitis / sinusitis (legacy card): combine with Yintang (EX-HN3) and Shangxing (GV23) to emphasize the nasal and frontal-sinus region.
clinical_pearls: 又名鼻通，臨床定位可沿鼻唇溝向上摸到鼻骨下凹陷；鼻塞、嗅覺減退、過敏性鼻炎常與 LI20 形成局部鼻竅對穴。
nameIntroZh: 上迎香意指位於迎香（LI20）上方的鼻旁穴；eLotus 另列鼻通、鼻穿、穿鼻等名，AD 主頁使用 Bitong（鼻通）。
nameIntroEn: Shangyingxiang means 'Upper Welcome Fragrance,' indicating its relation superior to Yingxiang (LI20). eLotus also lists Bitong, Bichuan, and Chuanbi; AD uses Bitong as the primary name.

location: 口腔內，舌背正中縫的中點。
locationEn: In the oral cavity, at the midpoint of the median dorsum of the tongue.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus：直刺0.1~0.2寸，或點刺出血。eLotus 未列點刺針具、出血量或止血流程。其另記古代曾以薑作隔物、用黃豆大小艾炷灸3~7壯治慢性咳嗽，但現今很少使用。
eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.1-0.2 cun or bloodletting. It does not specify the bloodletting instrument, quantity, or hemostasis protocol. It also records a historical method of 3-7 soybean-sized moxa cones over ginger for chronic cough, rarely used today.
functions: 袪痰開竅，調脾和胃，利舌降氣
functionsEn: Opens the orifices; Stops cough and arrests wheezing; Transforms Phlegm, harmonizes the Spleen/Stomach, benefits the tongue, and descends Qi (legacy content)
patterns: 食欲不振（既有內容；eLotus 本條未直接列）
patternsEn: Poor appetite (legacy content; not directly listed in the eLotus entry)
evidence: 四層查核：NCBAHM Appendix A 與現有課件均未找到聚泉專條；eLotus 精確頁／索引內容提供 EX-HN10、舌背正中定位、0.1~0.2寸或點刺出血、開竅／止咳平喘、完整主治，以及歷史隔薑3~7壯但現今少用；American Dragon 拼音索引未找到 Juquan，故不建立假詳情頁。既有袪痰、調脾和胃、利舌降氣、失語、食慾不振與配穴不刪，但標示來源缺口。WHO IRIS 僅作命名框架。

needling: eLotus：直刺0.1~0.2寸，或點刺出血；未列點刺針具、出血滴數或止血流程。
needlingEn: eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.1-0.2 cun or bloodletting; no bloodletting instrument, drop count, or hemostasis protocol is specified.
cautions: eLotus 僅支持直刺0.1~0.2寸或點刺出血，未提供點刺針具、出血量、消毒或止血流程。既有『避免深刺、嚴格口腔消毒、凝血異常／抗凝用藥／舌部感染慎用、施術後確認止血』保留為解剖與程序性風險提示，但不冒充四來源的完整規範。歷史隔薑灸3~7壯現今少用，不宜去掉其歷史限定。四來源未提供孕婦、兒童或其他高風險族群的本穴專屬規則，不猜。
cautionsEn: eLotus supports only perpendicular insertion 0.1-0.2 cun or bloodletting and gives no bloodletting instrument, quantity, antisepsis, or hemostasis protocol.

The legacy cautions to avoid deep insertion, use strict intraoral infection control, exercise caution with bleeding disorders/anticoagulants/local tongue infection, and confirm hemostasis are retained as anatomical and procedural risk notes, not as a complete four-source protocol.
The 3-7-cone ginger-moxa method is explicitly historical and rarely used today; that limitation must remain attached to the number.
The four sources provide no point-specific pregnancy, pediatric, or other high-risk-population rule; none is guessed.

anatomyEn: This is a tongue-body region at the midpoint of the dorsal midline. The four sources provide no layer-by-layer lingual neurovascular anatomy, acceptable bleeding quantity, or hemostasis protocol; 'midline' must not be interpreted as permission for deep insertion.

exam_importance_en: Juquan is not listed in NCBAHM Appendix A and has no dedicated current course entry, so it is not marked as Board core. Locate it on the dorsal midline halfway from tongue tip to root, distinct from midline sublingual Haiquan and bilateral sublingual Jinjin/Yuye.
exam_pearl: 聚泉抓『舌背中央』；海泉抓『舌下繫帶中央』；金津／玉液抓『舌下左右』。eLotus 的3~7壯是少用的歷史隔薑灸，不是現代常規。
exam_pearl_en: Juquan is at the center of the tongue dorsum; Haiquan is at the center of the sublingual frenulum; Jinjin/Yuye are bilateral beneath the tongue. The eLotus 3-7-cone method is historical ginger moxa, not routine modern practice.
combinePointsZh:
【舌強失語】聚泉配廉泉（CV23）、金津（EX-HN12）、玉液（EX-HN13）：局部利舌開音，兼清熱生津。
【中風後失語】聚泉配風池（GB20）、曲池（LI11）、內關（PC6）：息風通絡、醒神開音。
combinePointsEn:
Tongue stiffness / aphasia: Juquan with Lianquan (CV23), Jinjin (EX-HN12), and Yuye (EX-HN13) benefits the tongue, opens speech, clears Heat, and generates fluids.
Post-stroke aphasia: combine with Fengchi (GB20), Quchi (LI11), and Neiguan (PC6) to extinguish Wind, unblock collaterals, and support speech recovery.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 把聚泉主軸放在舌運動／味覺與慢性咳喘，而不只失語。精確頁目前直接開啟會出現驗證頁，但搜尋索引仍可讀到完整條目內容；此可讀性狀態已在 link_check 誠實記錄。
nameIntroZh: 聚泉可作『泉液匯聚』的字面記憶，對應舌體與口腔位置；此為名稱助記，不當作來源證實的功效。
nameIntroEn: Juquan may be remembered literally as 'Gathering Spring,' fitting its tongue/oral location; this is a name mnemonic, not source proof of an action.

combinePointsZh:

combinePointsEn:

exam_pearl_en: Jingbailao is not merely a neck-pain point: connect it with Lung consumption, chronic cough, steaming-bone tidal fever, and night sweats. Also remember the naming issue: Board/AD use Bailao, eLotus EX-HN15 uses Jingbailao, and eLotus notes overlap with EX-HN17.

cautionsEn: Depth discrepancy: eLotus lists perpendicular 0.5-0.8 cun; the AD page lists perpendicular 0.5-1 cun, straight 1-1.5 cun, and another perpendicular 0.5-0.8-cun version; the legacy card adds 0.8-1.2 cun. These four versions are not merged into a consensus range.
AD's local distention/soreness sometimes extending over the ipsilateral face is a reported sensation, not an instruction to deliberately seek an electrical sensation into the face.

The four sources do not provide layer-by-layer neurovascular anatomy, a skull-base safety boundary, or pregnancy, pediatric, or other high-risk protocols. The legacy advice to avoid deep insertion toward the skull base and use procedural caution in frail, dizzy, or stimulation-sensitive patients is retained but is not a source-stated contraindication.
The legacy card says moxa is applicable, but eLotus and AD do not support or quantify it; no moxa dose is inferred.

techniqueNotes:
AD：沿眶上緣直刺1~1.5寸，感覺可為眼球周圍脹感。既有卡片：沿眶上緣向後上方平／皮下刺0.5~1.0寸。方向、深度與術語不同，逐源並列；AD 的眼周脹感是來源描述，不是刻意追求刺向眼球的操作目標。eLotus 未收 Shangming，本網站的 EX-HN17 是 Bailao，故不能拿 Bailao 的0.3~0.5寸直刺／可灸套用於上明。
AD: straight insertion along the superior border of the orbit, 1-1.5 cun, with distention around the eyeball. Legacy card: posterior-superior transverse/subcutaneous insertion along the superior orbital border, 0.5-1.0 cun. exam_pearl: 扁桃體舊卡＝下頜角下凹陷、治急性扁桃體炎／咽腫／喉痹；但『朝舌根1.0~1.5寸』沒有四來源精確頁或解剖規範，不能當作可操作數值。
exam_pearl_en: The legacy Biantaoti card is below the mandibular angle for acute tonsillitis, swollen throat, and throat Bi, but its 1.0-1.5-cun tongue-root direction lacks an exact four-source page or anatomical protocol and is not an actionable validated value.
clinical_pearls: 課件中其他經穴可見扁桃體炎主治，但那只能證明疾病在課程出現，不能證明扁桃體穴本身的定位、功效或刺法。這張卡最重要的是保留內容同時阻止錯誤移植與高風險數值假驗證。
clinical_pearls_en: Course materials mention tonsillitis under other channel points, but that confirms only the condition's appearance in the curriculum—not Biantaoti's location, actions, or needling. This card preserves legacy content while preventing cross-point transfer and false validation of a high-risk value.

nameIntroEn: Biantaoti is a legacy name based on the tonsillar treatment area; no exact four-source entry explaining aliases, English translation, or naming history was found, so the etymology is not expanded.

location: 下腹部，臍下4寸（與中極 CV3 同水平），前正中線旁開3寸。eLotus 簡述為中極旁開3寸；課件與 AD 補足臍下4寸。
locationEn: On the lower abdomen, 4 cun below the umbilicus at the level of Zhongji (CV3), 3 cun lateral to the anterior midline. eLotus gives 3 cun lateral to CV3; the curriculum and AD supply the 4-cun-below-umbilicus landmark.
techniqueNotes:
課件：直刺0.5~1.2寸，或向恥骨聯合方向皮下／斜刺1.5~2.5寸；孕期禁針。eLotus：直刺0.8~1.2寸。AD：直刺0.5~1.2寸或0.8~1.2寸；子宮脫垂另記穿過肌層朝曲骨（CV2）、捻針纏住肌纖維後向上外提並固定20~30分鐘；可灸。各版本逐源保存，不合併成單一範圍；AD 特殊提拉法缺乏力道、組織終點、固定材料、停止與不良反應規範，只作來源記錄。
Curriculum: perpendicular 0.5-1.2 cun, or subcutaneous/oblique 1.5-2.5 cun toward the pubic symphysis; no needling during pregnancy. eLotus: perpendicular 0.8-1.2 cun. AD: perpendicular 0.5-1.2 or 0.8-1.2 cun; for uterine prolapse it additionally describes passing through the muscle layer toward Qugu (CV2), rotating to engage muscle fibers, lifting superior-laterally, and taping for 20-30 minutes; moxa is applicable. Versions remain source-separated. The AD lift method lacks force, tissue endpoint, fixation material, stopping, and adverse-event protocols and is recorded as source content, not a complete procedure.
functions: 升提調氣，調經止痛，調理衝任，溫補元氣與胞宮，清熱化濕
functionsEn: Raises and regulates Qi; Regulates menstruation and alleviates pain; Regulates Chong/Ren; Tonifies and warms Yuan Qi and the uterus; Clears Heat and transforms Dampness
cautions: 【孕期】課件明列『No Needling in Pregnancy』，因此本卡維持孕期禁針。AD 雖列『Calms the fetus』但禁忌欄空白，不能解讀為孕期施針或灸法許可。【多技法差異】課件直刺0.5~1.2寸與向恥骨聯合皮下／斜刺1.5~2.5寸；eLotus直刺0.8~1.2寸；AD直刺0.5~1.2或0.8~1.2寸，逐源保存，不做假共識。【特殊提拉法】AD 的子宮脫垂肌層提拉、捻轉、向上外固定20~30分鐘缺乏力道、組織終點、固定材料、停止／出血／疼痛規則與高風險族群規範；不得視為完整操作流程。【腹部解剖缺口】四來源未提供腹膜、膀胱／盆腔臟器界線、膀胱充盈、術後／疝氣、感染、抗凝／出血風險或體型差異。【灸法】課件／AD僅說可灸，無劑量與孕期安全；不補造。
evidence: 四層查核：NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A 明列 Zigong；課件有 M-CA-18 Uterus Point 專條，提供定位、孕期禁針、0.5~1.2寸直刺／向恥骨聯合1.5~2.5寸斜刺、升提調氣／調經止痛與婦科主治；eLotus 精確 EX-CA1 Zigongxue 頁提供 CV3旁3寸、直刺0.8~1.2寸、升提調氣／調經止痛及子宮脫垂／月經不調；AD M-CA-18 頁補全別名、兩個直刺版本、子宮脫垂提拉法、可灸、八項功效、婦科／泌尿／炎症主治與四組配穴。既有調理衝任、暖宮、帶下、不孕及痛經配穴保留並分層標示。WHO IRIS 僅作命名框架。

anatomyEn: This point lies in the lower abdominal wall 4 cun below the umbilicus and 3 cun lateral to the midline. Database/eLotus: EX-CA1 Zigongxue (Uterus Point), also called Zigong

cautionsEn: The curriculum explicitly states 'No Needling in Pregnancy,' so this card retains pregnancy as a needling contraindication. AD's action 'Calms the fetus' and blank contraindication field do not constitute permission for needling or moxa during pregnancy.

Technique ranges remain source-separated: curriculum perpendicular 0.5-1.2 cun or subcutaneous/oblique 1.5-2.5 cun toward the pubic symphysis; eLotus perpendicular 0.8-1.2 cun; AD perpendicular 0.5-1.2 or 0.8-1.2 cun.

AD's prolapse technique—muscle-layer insertion toward CV2, rotation, superior-lateral lift, and taping for 20-30 minutes—lacks force, tissue endpoint, fixation material, stopping/bleeding/pain rules, and high-risk population criteria; it is not a complete procedure.

The four sources provide no peritoneal, bladder/pelvic-organ, bladder-filling, postoperative/hernia, infection, anticoagulation/bleeding-risk, or body-build protocol. Curriculum/AD say moxa is applicable but give no dose or pregnancy safety.

Ceaseless uterine bleeding: Zigong with Zhongji (CV3), Shimen (CV5), and Shenshu (BL23), as listed by AD.
Chronic pelveoperitonitis: Zigong with Guanyuan (CV4), Gongsun (SP4), Xuehai (SP10), and Yinlingquan (SP9), as listed by AD.
Leukorrhea: Zigong with Zhongji (CV3) and Yinlingquan (SP9), as listed by AD.
Dysmenorrhea: Zigong with Guanyuan (CV4) and Sanyinjiao (SP6), retained from the legacy card; no Zigong-specific support for this combination was found in the four-source pass.

exam_importance_en: NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A explicitly lists Zigong. Know its location 4 cun below the umbilicus at CV3 level and 3 cun lateral, the curriculum M-CA-18 versus eLotus/database EX-CA1 codes, and no needling during pregnancy.
exam_pearl: 子宮穴考點＝CV3水平旁3寸，升提調氣、調經止痛，抓子宮脫垂／月經不調／不孕；同音勿混 CV19 紫宮。AD 的『安胎』不是推翻課件孕期禁針。
exam_pearl_en: Zigong is 3 cun lateral to CV3, raises/regulates Qi and regulates menstruation/pain, with uterine prolapse, irregular menses, and infertility as key indications. Do not confuse it with CV19 Purple Palace, and AD's 'calms the fetus' does not override the curriculum's pregnancy prohibition.
clinical_pearls: 四源核心交集是定位、升提調氣、調經止痛與子宮脫垂／月經不調。AD 擴展到清熱化濕、婦科出血、泌尿與盆腔炎症，並列四組配穴；這些按來源保存，不擴寫成對所有盆腔疾病的通用適應證。
clinical_pearls_en: The four-source core is location, raising/regulating Qi, regulating menstruation and pain, and uterine prolapse/irregular menses. AD extends the card to Heat/Damp actions, uterine bleeding, urinary and pelvic inflammatory indications, and four combinations; these remain source-specific rather than a universal pelvic-disease claim.

location: 下腹部，關元（CV4）水平，前正中線旁開4寸；亦即臍下3寸、旁開4寸。
locationEn: On the lower abdomen, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline at the level of Guanyuan (CV4), equivalent to 3 cun below the umbilicus and 4 cun lateral.
cunMeasurement: 先定關元（CV4，臍下3寸），再在同一水平線向外量4寸。eLotus 與 AD 均以『CV4水平／CV4旁開4寸』定位。
anatomyZh: 位於下腹壁、關元（CV4）水平的外側區。AD 的子宮脫垂特殊法明載針由提托朝曲骨（CV2）方向通過肌層；但 Board Outline、現有課件、eLotus 與 AD 均未提供逐層腹壁、腹膜、膀胱或其他盆腹腔臟器界線，也未說明個體體型差異，因此不自行補造深層解剖安全界線。
anatomyEn: The point lies on the lateral lower abdominal wall at the level of Guanyuan (CV4). For uterine prolapse, AD specifically directs the needle through the muscular layer toward Qugu (CV2), but the Board Outline, current curriculum, eLotus, and AD provide no layer-by-layer abdominal-wall, peritoneal, bladder, or other abdominopelvic-organ boundaries and no body-build adjustments; deeper safety limits are therefore not inferred.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus：直刺0.8~1.2寸。American Dragon：直刺1~1.5寸，或直刺0.8~1.2寸；前者記下腹脹痠，有時出現子宮上提感。AD 另載子宮脫垂特殊法：由提托朝曲骨（CV2）方向穿行肌層，捻轉使肌纖維纏針，再向上外提拉並貼膚固定20~30分鐘；此為來源所載的高階技法，不是完整操作規程。舊卡『向腹股溝斜刺0.8~1.2寸』及後來批次的『直刺0.3~0.8寸、可灸或點刺出血』在本輪四層查核均未找到支持，故不再列為可執行方法。
eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.8-1.2 cun. American Dragon: straight insertion 1-1.5 cun, or perpendicular insertion 0.8-1.2 cun; the former may produce lower-abdominal distention/soreness and sometimes a lifting sensation in the uterus. AD also records an advanced uterine-prolapse method: direct the needle through the muscular layer toward Qugu (CV2), rotate until muscle fibers wrap the needle, pull superiorly and laterally, and tape it to the skin for 20-30 minutes. This is source-transcribed advanced technique, not a complete procedural protocol. The legacy oblique 0.8-1.2-cun inguinal-directed method and the later bulk value of perpendicular 0.3-0.8 cun with moxa or bloodletting were not supported by the four-layer review and are not retained as executable methods.
acumethodZh: eLotus：直刺0.8~1.2寸。AD：直刺1~1.5寸，或直刺0.8~1.2寸；子宮脫垂另載朝曲骨（CV2）穿行肌層、捻轉纏肌、向上外提拉並貼膚固定20~30分鐘的特殊法。各版本逐源保存，不合併為單一深度；特殊法僅供辨識來源內容，不能取代正式臨床訓練與完整安全規程。
acumethodEn: eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.8-1.2 cun. AD: straight insertion 1-1.5 cun or perpendicular insertion 0.8-1.2 cun; for uterine prolapse it additionally describes a CV2-directed muscular-layer technique with rotation, superior-lateral lifting, and taping for 20-30 minutes. The variants remain source-separated rather than merged into one depth, and the special method is recorded for source recognition only—not as a substitute for formal clinical training or a complete safety protocol.
moxaZh: 現有課件沒有提托專條；eLotus 與 AD 的提托精確頁面均未說明艾灸。不得由來源沉默推定可灸、禁灸、時間或壯數。
moxaEn: The current curriculum has no dedicated Tituo entry, and neither the exact eLotus nor AD Tituo page addresses moxibustion. Source silence does not establish permission, prohibition, duration, or cone count.
functions: 調理並升提氣機；升陽舉陷；調理下焦
functionsEn: Regulates and raises Qi; Raises Yang and lifts collapse; Regulates the Lower Jiao
functionsZhList: 升陽舉陷（既有表述，與子宮脫垂主治相符）

exam_importance_en: NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A explicitly lists Tituo. Know its location 4 cun lateral to Guanyuan (CV4), its regulation and raising of Qi, and uterine prolapse as the core indication, while recognizing the database EX-CA2, eLotus Ex-CA3, and AD N-CA-4 source-code discrepancy.
exam_pearl: 提托＝關元水平向外4寸，重點是『提』：調理升提氣機，抓子宮脫垂；痛經、疝氣與小腹脹痛為延伸主治。AD 的提拉固定法是高階來源技法，不可只憑卡片操作。
exam_pearl_en: Tituo is 4 cun lateral to Guanyuan: think 'lifting'—regulate and raise Qi, with uterine prolapse as the anchor indication; dysmenorrhea, hernia, and lower-abdominal distention/pain are extensions. AD's lift-and-tape method is an advanced source technique and must not be performed from the card alone.
patterns: 疝氣（既有卡片作腹股溝疝氣）
patternsEn: Hernia (specified as inguinal hernia in the legacy card)
cautions: 【孕期】原卡明列『孕婦禁用』，依不刪弱安全警告原則保留；但 Board Outline、現有課件、eLotus 與 AD 本輪均未提供提托的孕期禁針或孕期灸法條文，因此此警告仍待具名教材／婦產科針灸來源核實，不能反向解讀為可用。【下腹部解剖】兩個精確網頁均提供0.8~1.5寸刺深，AD 特殊法更要求穿行肌層朝CV2，但未交代腹壁層次、腹膜／膀胱／盆腹腔臟器界線、膀胱充盈、體型差異、術後腹部或出血風險處理。【提拉固定法】AD 的捻轉纏肌、上外提拉與貼膚20~30分鐘沒有提供力道、組織終點、固定材料、無菌、疼痛／出血停止規則或高風險族群規範，不能視為完整操作流程。【疝氣】AD 雖列疝氣為主治，但未提供嵌頓／絞窄等急症排除流程；卡片主治不能取代急症評估。
cautionsEn: Pregnancy: the legacy card states 'do not use during pregnancy,' and that warning is retained under the no-safety-downgrade rule. However, the Board Outline, current curriculum, eLotus, and AD provide no Tituo-specific pregnancy needling or moxa statement in this review; the warning still needs a named textbook or obstetric-acupuncture source and must not be inverted into permission.

Lower-abdominal anatomy: both exact pages give depths of 0.8-1.5 cun, and AD's special method traverses the muscular layer toward CV2, but neither page supplies abdominal-wall layers, peritoneal/bladder/abdominopelvic-organ limits, bladder-filling guidance, body-build adjustments, postoperative-abdominal guidance, or bleeding-risk management.

Lift-and-tape method: AD does not specify force, tissue endpoint, fixation material, asepsis, pain/bleeding stop rules, or high-risk populations for the rotation, superior-lateral lift, and 20-30-minute taping method; it is not a complete procedural protocol.
Hernia: AD lists hernia as an indication but provides no screening pathway for incarceration or strangulation; the card indication does not replace urgent evaluation.
combinePointsZh:
【子宮脫垂；AD】提托配中極透曲骨（CV3→CV2）、足三里（ST36）、三陰交（SP6）。
【子宮脫垂；AD 另案】提托配百會（GV20）、足三里（ST36）、三陰交（SP6）。
combinePointsEn:
Uterine prolapse (AD): Tituo with Zhongji through to Qugu (CV3→CV2), Zusanli (ST36), and Sanyinjiao (SP6).
Alternative uterine-prolapse set (AD): Tituo with Baihui (GV20), Zusanli (ST36), and Sanyinjiao (SP6).
clinical_pearls: eLotus 與 AD 的核心交集很集中：CV4水平旁4寸、調理升提氣機、子宮脫垂／痛經／小腹脹痛、直刺0.8~1.2寸。AD 另擴展1~1.5寸直刺、疝氣、兩組配穴與提拉固定法；這些按來源分層保留，不升格為共同標準。
clinical_pearls_en: The eLotus/AD core is narrow and consistent: 4 cun lateral at CV4 level, regulation and raising of Qi, uterine prolapse/dysmenorrhea/lower-abdominal distention and pain, and perpendicular insertion 0.8-1.2 cun. AD additionally gives a 1-1.5-cun version, hernia, two combinations, and a lift-and-tape method; these remain source-specific rather than consensus.
nameIntroZh: 提托的名稱直接提示『提舉、托起』。eLotus 英譯 Life and Support；AD 英譯 Life and Support Orifice。
nameIntroEn: The name Tituo conveys lifting and supporting. eLotus translates it as Life and Support, while AD uses Life and Support Orifice.
otherNamesZh: AD 英譯：Life and Support Orifice
evidence: 四層查核：NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A 明列 Tituo；現有 curriculum/acupoints 以提托、Tituo、Ex-CA2／3、N-CA-4 搜尋均未找到專條，故明示課件缺口；eLotus Ex-CA3 精確頁提供定位、調理升提氣機、三項主治與直刺0.8~1.2寸；AD N-CA-4 精確頁補1~1.5寸直刺及針感、0.8~1.2寸版本、子宮脫垂提拉固定法、疝氣與兩組配穴。原卡的升陽舉陷、調理下焦、腹股溝疝氣與孕婦禁用均保留並標示為既有內容；無來源支持的斜刺向腹股溝、0.3~0.8寸、艾灸與點刺出血不再作為可執行技法。代碼有實質差異：本庫穩定碼 EX-CA2，eLotus 為 Ex-CA3，AD 為 N-CA-4；本輪未取得可逐點核對的 WHO 提托條目，因此不把任一來源別碼宣稱為已核實的 WHO 提托碼。

needling: eLotus：直刺0.8~1.2寸。AD：直刺1~1.5寸，或直刺0.8~1.2寸；子宮脫垂另載朝曲骨（CV2）穿行肌層、捻轉纏肌、向上外提拉並貼膚固定20~30分鐘的特殊法。各版本逐源保存，不合併為單一深度；特殊法僅供辨識來源內容，不能取代正式臨床訓練與完整安全規程。
needlingEn: eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.8-1.2 cun. AD: straight insertion 1-1.5 cun or perpendicular insertion 0.8-1.2 cun; for uterine prolapse it additionally describes a CV2-directed muscular-layer technique with rotation, superior-lateral lifting, and taping for 20-30 minutes. The variants remain source-separated rather than merged into one depth, and the special method is recorded for source recognition only—not as a substitute for formal clinical training or a complete safety protocol.

location: 下腹部，以患者兩口角之間的長度為一邊，作等邊三角形；將頂角置於臍心、底邊保持水平，底邊左右兩角即為兩個施灸點。
locationEn: On the lower abdomen, use the distance between the patient's mouth corners as the side length of an equilateral triangle. Place its apex at the center of the umbilicus with the base horizontal; the two lower corners are the treatment points.
cunMeasurement: 不用固定寸數；取患者兩口角間的實際長度作等邊三角形邊長。臍心為上方頂角，水平底邊的兩角為穴。
anatomyZh: 兩點位於臍下腹壁表面，依患者口寬作幾何定位。eLotus 與雲端中醫均將其描述為灸法用點，未提供皮膚、皮下組織、腹壁層次或腹腔臟器解剖；本輪也沒有可支持刺針深度的解剖資料，因此不得從位置自行推導針刺法。
anatomyEn: The two points lie on the lower abdominal surface and are located geometrically from the patient's mouth width. eLotus and CloudTCM describe them as moxibustion points but provide no skin, subcutaneous, abdominal-wall, or intra-abdominal anatomy. No anatomical source in this review supports a needling depth, so a needle technique must not be inferred from location.
techniqueNotes:
本輪查到的精確來源只支持艾灸，不支持刺針或點刺出血。eLotus：灸患側的對側點，未列壯數。雲端中醫『疝氣穴』頁：左側偏墜灸右穴、右側偏墜灸左穴，亦可雙側同灸；每次十四壯（二七壯），但頁面未交代十四壯是每點或總量。舊卡記『艾炷灸5~7壯』，本輪 Board、課件、eLotus、AD 與雲端中醫精確頁均未證實此數值，故只作未核實舊值保留。
Exact sources reviewed in this pass support moxibustion only, not needling or bloodletting. eLotus: moxa the point opposite the affected side, with no cone count. CloudTCM's Hernia Point page: moxa the contralateral point for unilateral descent, or both sides; fourteen cones (two groups of seven) per treatment, although the page does not clarify whether fourteen is per point or total. The legacy card states 5-7 moxa cones, but this number was not confirmed by the Board, curriculum, eLotus, AD, or the exact CloudTCM page and is retained only as an unverified legacy value.
acumethodZh: 不列刺針法。eLotus 與雲端中醫精確頁均以灸法描述三角灸；本輪未找到可支持原批次『直刺0.3~0.8寸或點刺出血』的來源。
acumethodEn: No needle technique is listed. Both exact eLotus and CloudTCM entries describe Sanjiaojiu as a moxibustion method; no source reviewed in this pass supports the bulk-added 'perpendicular 0.3-0.8 cun or prick to bleed' instruction.
moxaZh: eLotus：依病側取對側點施灸，未列直接／間接灸、艾炷大小或壯數。雲端中醫：左病灸右、右病灸左，亦可雙側同灸；每次十四壯（二七壯），但未明示十四壯為單點或總量。舊卡5~7壯未獲本輪來源支持，不作可執行劑量。兩個來源均未交代隔物、皮膚保護、熱源距離、灼傷停止規則或孕期灸法安全。
moxaEn: eLotus directs moxibustion on the point opposite the affected side but gives no direct/indirect method, cone size, or count. CloudTCM directs the contralateral point, or both sides, and states fourteen cones (two groups of seven) per treatment, without clarifying whether the count is per point or total. The legacy 5-7-cone value is unsupported in this review and is not presented as an executable dose. Neither source gives an insulating method, skin protection, heat distance, burn stop rule, or pregnancy-specific moxa guidance.
functions: 止痛；溫通經絡；散寒行氣；溫中止瀉
functionsEn: Relieves pain; Warms and unblocks the channels; Dispels Cold and moves Qi; Warms the Middle and stops diarrhea

exam_importance: 不在 NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A 重點清單，優先級低於 Tituo、Zigong 等明列穴位。若複習本穴，核心是口角寬作等邊三角形、臍為頂角、下兩角取穴，以及病側取對側施灸；不得把本庫 EX-CA3 誤當 eLotus Ex-CA3（提托）。
exam_importance_en: Sanjiaojiu is not in the NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A priority list. If reviewed, know the mouth-width equilateral triangle with the umbilicus as apex, the two lower corners as points, and contralateral moxibustion. Do not confuse database EX-CA3 with eLotus Ex-CA3, which is Tituo.
exam_pearl: 三角灸靠幾何取穴，不靠固定寸數：口角寬＝三角形邊長，臍為頂角，下方兩角為穴。名稱已提示治法是灸；eLotus 取病側對側，不支持原卡的直刺或點刺出血。
exam_pearl_en: Sanjiaojiu uses geometry rather than a fixed cun measurement: mouth width equals the triangle side, the umbilicus is the apex, and the two lower corners are the points. Its name signals moxibustion; eLotus treats the side opposite the disorder and does not support the legacy needling or bloodletting method.
cautions: 【只核實灸法】本輪精確來源均未列刺針或點刺出血；原批次的直刺0.3~0.8寸、避開血管神經與無菌針刺警語屬錯置，不能再讀成三角灸的操作。【灸量衝突】雲端中醫列每次十四壯，但未說明是每點或總量；舊卡5~7壯無具名來源。兩者不可合併成共識範圍，也不能由卡片自行選量。【熱傷害缺口】eLotus 與雲端中醫均未交代直接／間接灸、艾炷大小、隔物、皮膚保護、熱源距離或灼傷停止規則。【孕期】舊卡『孕婦慎用』予以保留，但 Board、課件、eLotus、AD 索引與雲端中醫精確頁均未提供本穴孕期灸法條文；來源沉默不等於安全許可。【疝氣急症】來源未提供嵌頓或絞窄疝的排除與轉診流程，疝氣主治不能取代急症評估。
cautionsEn: Moxibustion only was verified: none of the exact sources reviewed lists needling or bloodletting. The bulk-added perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun method and needle-related asepsis/vessel/nerve warning were misplaced and must not be read as Sanjiaojiu technique.

Dose discrepancy: CloudTCM states fourteen cones per treatment without clarifying whether this is per point or total, while the legacy 5-7-cone value has no named source. They are not merged into a consensus range and the card cannot select a dose.
Thermal-safety gap: eLotus and CloudTCM do not specify direct versus indirect moxa, cone size, insulation, skin protection, heat distance, or burn stopping rules.

Pregnancy: the legacy 'use caution in pregnancy' warning is retained, but the Board, curriculum, eLotus, AD index, and exact CloudTCM page provide no point-specific pregnancy-moxa statement. Source silence is not permission.
Hernia emergency: the sources provide no screening or referral pathway for incarcerated or strangulated hernia; an indication on this card does not replace urgent assessment.
combinePointsZh: 【疝氣偏墜；雲端中醫】三角灸配關元（CV4）、氣海（CV6）、大敦（LR1），取溫補下元、疏肝理氣之意。此配伍來自雲端中醫『疝氣穴』詞典頁；eLotus 與 AD 本輪未列配穴。
combinePointsEn: For unilateral hernia descent (CloudTCM): Sanjiaojiu with Guanyuan (CV4), Qihai (CV6), and Dadun (LR1), intended to warm and support the Lower Origin while coursing Liver Qi. This combination comes from CloudTCM's Hernia Point dictionary entry; no combination was found in eLotus or the AD index review.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 與雲端中醫的共同核心是口寬三角定位、疝氣／腹痛與病側取對側灸。雲端中醫另補十四壯、雙側同灸選項、寒疝／陰囊腫痛與CV4-CV6-LR1配伍；慢性腹瀉、不孕與5~7壯仍只是既有卡片內容，等待課本頁碼核實。
clinical_pearls_en: The eLotus/CloudTCM core is the mouth-width triangle, hernia/abdominal pain, and contralateral moxibustion. CloudTCM additionally supplies fourteen cones, an option to treat both sides, Cold-type hernia/scrotal pain, and the CV4-CV6-LR1 combination. Chronic diarrhea, infertility, and 5-7 cones remain legacy content pending a cited textbook page.
nameIntroZh: 三角灸因以口角寬作三角形定位並施灸而得名。eLotus 英譯 Triangle Moxa；eLotus 與雲端中醫均把疝氣穴、臍旁穴列為相關別名，eLotus 另列 Qipang。
nameIntroEn: Sanjiaojiu is named for its triangular geometric location method and moxibustion treatment. eLotus translates it as Triangle Moxa. Both eLotus and CloudTCM associate it with Hernia Point and Side of Umbilicus; eLotus additionally lists Qipang.
otherNamesZh: Qipang（eLotus 所列別名，與其 Ex-CA2 同名頁需辨別）
otherNamesEn: Qipang (eLotus-listed alias; distinguish from its separate Ex-CA2 page)
evidence: 四層與補充來源查核：NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A 未列 Sanjiaojiu；curriculum/acupoints 以中文、拼音、別名與代碼搜尋均無專條；eLotus 精確 Ex-CA6 頁提供口寬三角定位、疝氣／腹痛、止痛、病側取對側灸及疝氣穴／臍旁／Qipang 別名；American Dragon 拼音索引沒有 Sanjiaojiu、Sanjiao、Qipang 或 Triangular 條目，因此沒有宣稱 AD 專頁內容。補充的雲端中醫『疝氣穴』精確詞典頁提供古籍脈絡、等邊三角定位、對側或雙側灸、十四壯、寒疝／陰囊腫痛、溫通散寒行氣及CV4-CV6-LR1配伍。舊卡慢性腹瀉、不孕、溫中止瀉、5~7壯與孕婦慎用均保留並標為未核實舊值；無來源的直刺0.3~0.8寸與點刺出血已從可執行欄位撤下。本庫穩定碼 EX-CA3 不更名；eLotus 的 Sanjiaojiu 為 Ex-CA6，而 eLotus Ex-CA3 是 Tituo。

needling: 不列刺針法。本輪精確來源只支持艾灸：eLotus 取病側對側點，未列壯數；雲端中醫可取對側或雙側，每次十四壯，但未說明為每點或總量。舊卡5~7壯未獲具名來源支持。
needlingEn: No needle technique is listed. Exact sources support moxibustion only: eLotus treats the point opposite the affected side without a cone count; CloudTCM allows contralateral or bilateral treatment and states fourteen cones per treatment without clarifying per-point versus total. The legacy 5-7-cone value lacks a named supporting source.

location: 上腹部，臍中上2寸的水平線上，左右各取一穴。eLotus 定位為距臍中旁開4寸；American Dragon 的 Weishangxue（N-CA-18）頁寫作臍上2寸、距REN-10下脘旁開4寸，並另引旁開2.5寸一說。舊卡旁開3寸未獲本輪精確來源支持，故不把三個數值合併成單一定位。
locationEn: On the upper abdomen, on the horizontal level 2 cun superior to the umbilicus, with one point on each side. eLotus locates it 4 cun lateral to the umbilicus. American Dragon's related Weishangxue (N-CA-18) page states 2 cun above the navel and 4 cun lateral to REN-10 Xiawan, while also citing an alternate 2.5-cun lateral location. The legacy card's 3-cun lateral value was not confirmed by an exact source in this review and is not merged with the other measurements.
cunMeasurement: 共同垂直基準為臍中上2寸。旁開值有分歧：eLotus 4寸；AD Weishangxue 主說4寸、另說2.5寸；舊卡3寸未核實。取穴時必須依所採來源標準，不可把2.5、3、4寸平均或視為等同。
anatomyZh: 兩穴位於上腹部前外側體表。eLotus 明列皮下進針，AD 明列橫刺，但兩頁均未提供皮膚、皮下組織、腹直肌鞘／腹外斜肌區域、腹膜或腹腔臟器的逐層解剖，也未提供不同體型的安全邊界。2～3寸是沿皮下／橫向的行針長度，不可改讀為垂直刺深。
anatomyEn: The paired points lie on the anterolateral upper abdominal surface. eLotus explicitly specifies subcutaneous needling and American Dragon specifies transverse insertion, but neither page provides layered skin, subcutaneous, rectus-sheath/external-oblique-region, peritoneal, or intra-abdominal anatomy, nor body-habitus safety boundaries. The 2-3-cun value is a subcutaneous/transverse needle-travel distance and must not be reinterpreted as perpendicular depth.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus（Weishang Ex-CA7）：向臍中或天樞（ST25）方向皮下刺2～3寸；艾灸10～15分鐘。American Dragon 的相關 Weishangxue（N-CA-18）頁：向臍中或天樞方向橫刺2～3寸，得氣描述為腹部脹、臍部牽緊與胃部收縮感。舊卡『向下斜刺1.0～1.5寸』本輪未獲 Board、課件、eLotus 或 AD 精確頁支持；批次加入的『直刺0.3～0.8寸、可灸或點刺出血』亦不符合兩個精確頁的針刺方向，故只作未核實舊值記錄。
eLotus (Weishang Ex-CA7): subcutaneous insertion 2-3 cun toward the umbilicus or Tianshu (ST25), with moxa for 10-15 minutes. American Dragon's related Weishangxue (N-CA-18) page: transverse insertion 2-3 cun toward the umbilicus or ST25, with a described sensation of abdominal distention, a tightened umbilical region, and contraction of the Stomach. The legacy downward-oblique 1.0-1.5-cun method was not confirmed by the Board, curriculum, eLotus, or an exact AD page. The bulk-added perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun, moxa-or-bloodletting instruction also conflicts with the exact pages' needle direction and is retained only as an unverified legacy value.
acumethodZh: 依 eLotus 與 AD Weishangxue 的共同內容，採皮下／橫刺，朝臍中或天樞（ST25）方向進針2～3寸。此數字是沿腹壁表面的行針距離，不是直刺深度。AD 的得氣描述可記錄觀察，但兩源都沒有提供進針層次確認、停止規則或體型調整。
acumethodEn: The shared eLotus/AD method is subcutaneous or transverse insertion 2-3 cun toward the umbilicus or Tianshu (ST25). This measurement is needle travel along the abdominal wall, not perpendicular depth. American Dragon describes the resulting sensation, but neither source provides layer-confirmation, stopping criteria, or body-habitus adjustments.
moxaZh: eLotus 列艾灸10～15分鐘，但未交代溫和灸／直接灸、艾條距離、局部皮膚保護、熱傷害停止規則或療程頻率。AD Weishangxue 頁的艾灸與禁忌欄為空，不能用其沉默補足安全細節。
moxaEn: eLotus lists moxibustion for 10-15 minutes but does not specify gentle versus direct moxa, moxa-stick distance, local skin protection, thermal-injury stopping rules, or treatment frequency. The American Dragon Weishangxue page has no moxa or contraindication instruction; that silence cannot supply the missing safety details.

exam_importance: 胃上不在 NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A 明列重點，亦無本地課件專條。若複習本穴，核心是辨認來源代碼與定位分歧，以及2～3寸屬朝臍／天樞方向的皮下或橫向行針，不是垂直刺深。
exam_importance_en: Weishang is not named in the NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A priority list and has no dedicated local curriculum entry. If studied, focus on the source-code/location discrepancies and remember that 2-3 cun describes subcutaneous or transverse travel toward the umbilicus/ST25, not perpendicular depth.
exam_pearl: 胃上以胃下垂為最一致主治；eLotus 與 AD 相關頁共同支持朝臍中或天樞橫向2～3寸。定位旁開有4寸、2.5寸與未核實舊卡3寸三種，不可混成單一答案。
exam_pearl_en: Gastroptosis is the most consistent indication. eLotus and the related AD entry both support 2-3 cun transversely toward the umbilicus or ST25. Lateral locations of 4 cun, an alternate 2.5 cun, and the unverified legacy 3 cun must remain source-specific rather than being merged.
action_tags_en: Tonify the Middle and Benefit Qi
Harmonize the Stomach and Relieve Pain
Strengthen the Spleen and Harmonize the Stomach
cautions: 【方向即安全邊界】eLotus 與 AD 相關頁均指定皮下／橫刺朝臍中或天樞2～3寸；此長度不可改讀為垂直刺深，亦不支持原批次直刺0.3～0.8寸或點刺出血。【定位分歧】eLotus 旁開4寸；AD 主說4寸、另說2.5寸；舊卡3寸未核實。沒有權威裁決前不可平均或任選。【解剖缺口】兩頁都沒有逐層腹壁、腹膜／臟器邊界、不同體型、針具規格、進針層確認或停止規則。【艾灸缺口】eLotus 只列10～15分鐘，沒有灸法種類、熱源距離、皮膚保護或灼傷停止標準。【孕期】舊卡『孕婦慎用』予以保留，但 Board、課件、eLotus 與 AD Weishangxue 頁均未提供本穴孕期針灸條文；來源沉默不等於安全許可。【AD 身分缺口】AD 索引的 Weishang 連結本輪無法開啟；可核讀的是另列的 Weishangxue N-CA-18，故內容以相關條目標示，不冒充已核實的 AD Weishang 專頁。
cautionsEn: Direction is part of the safety boundary: eLotus and the related AD page specify subcutaneous/transverse insertion 2-3 cun toward the umbilicus or ST25. This travel length must not be reinterpreted as perpendicular depth and does not support the bulk-added perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun or bloodletting method.

Location discrepancy: eLotus gives 4 cun lateral; AD gives 4 cun with an alternate 2.5-cun statement; the legacy card's 3-cun value is unverified. They must not be averaged or selected without a governing standard.
Anatomy gap: neither page supplies layered abdominal-wall, peritoneal/visceral boundaries, body-habitus adjustments, needle specifications, layer confirmation, or stopping criteria.
Moxa gap: eLotus supplies only 10-15 minutes, without method type, heat distance, skin protection, or burn stopping criteria.

Pregnancy: the legacy 'use caution in pregnancy' statement is retained, but the Board, curriculum, eLotus, and AD Weishangxue page provide no point-specific pregnancy instruction. Source silence is not permission.

AD identity gap: the index's Weishang link could not be opened in this review. The readable page is the separately listed Weishangxue N-CA-18, so its content is labeled as a related entry rather than misrepresented as a verified AD Weishang page.
combinePointsZh: 【胃下垂；American Dragon Weishangxue】AD 表格在胃下垂欄同列『Join to REN-8 Qizhong』、中脘（CV12）、氣海（CV6）、足三里（ST36）。原表的 join 語法沒有交代方向、深度或是否為透刺，不轉寫成可執行針法。【腹脹；American Dragon Weishangxue】AD 另列氣海（CV6）joined to 中極（CV3）；同樣只保留來源原意與主治，不自行補操作程序。
combinePointsEn: For gastroptosis (American Dragon Weishangxue), the table lists 'Join to REN-8 Qizhong' together with Zhongwan (CV12), Qihai (CV6), and Zusanli (ST36). Because the source does not explain the direction, depth, or whether 'join' means through-needling, this is not rewritten as an executable procedure. For abdominal distention, AD additionally lists Qihai (CV6) joined to Zhongji (CV3); again, the source wording and indication are retained without inventing technique details.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 與 AD Weishangxue 的共同核心是胃下垂、腹脹，以及朝臍中／天樞橫向2～3寸。eLotus 再補胃痛、反酸、補中益氣、和胃止痛與艾灸10～15分鐘；AD 補得氣描述與兩組配穴。消化不良、健脾和胃、升提胃氣、旁開3寸、向下斜刺1～1.5寸與孕期慎用仍屬既有卡片內容，等待具名課本頁碼核實。
clinical_pearls_en: The eLotus/AD Weishangxue core is gastroptosis, abdominal distention, and transverse 2-3-cun insertion toward the umbilicus or ST25. eLotus adds stomach pain, acid reflux, tonifying the Middle/benefiting Qi, harmonizing the Stomach/relieving pain, and 10-15 minutes of moxa. AD adds a needling-sensation description and two combination groups. Indigestion, Spleen strengthening, raising Stomach Qi, the 3-cun lateral location, downward-oblique 1.0-1.5-cun method, and pregnancy caution remain legacy content pending a cited textbook page.
nameIntroZh: 『胃上』指穴位在胃區上腹部並用於胃下垂等病症。eLotus 英譯 Above the Stomach，並列提垂穴（Lift the Sunken Point）為別名；AD 可核讀的相關條目名為 Weishangxue，英譯 Above the Stomach Orifice。
nameIntroEn: Weishang refers to an upper-abdominal point used for disorders including gastroptosis. eLotus translates it as Above the Stomach and lists Lift the Sunken Point (Tichuixue) as an alias. The readable related AD entry is named Weishangxue and translated Above the Stomach Orifice.
evidence: 四層查核：NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A 未列 Weishang；curriculum/acupoints 以胃上、Weishang、EX-CA4、Ex-CA7、提垂穴與Weishangxue搜尋均無專條（唯一『胃上』命中為肺經循行文字，非穴位證據）。eLotus 精確 Weishang Ex-CA7 頁提供臍上2寸、旁開4寸、補中益氣、和胃止痛、胃下垂／腹脹／胃痛／反酸、向臍或ST25皮下刺2～3寸、艾灸10～15分鐘及提垂穴別名。American Dragon 拼音索引分別列 Weishang 與 Weishangxue；Weishang 連結本輪無法開啟，可核讀的 Weishangxue N-CA-18 頁與本穴核心高度相近，提供主說旁開4寸、另說2.5寸、朝臍或ST25橫刺2～3寸、胃下垂／腹脹、得氣描述及配伍表，但以相關條目標示而非冒充同碼。CloudTCM 搜尋未找到可核讀的胃上專頁，泛用目錄連結已移除。舊卡旁開3寸、向下斜刺1～1.5寸、消化不良、健脾和胃、升提胃氣與孕期慎用均保留為未核實舊值；批次加入的直刺0.3～0.8寸與點刺出血不再列為可執行技法。

needlingEn: Subcutaneous/transverse insertion 2-3 cun toward the umbilicus or Tianshu (ST25); this is needle travel along the abdominal wall, not perpendicular depth. eLotus additionally lists moxa for 10-15 minutes. The legacy downward-oblique 1.0-1.5-cun method and the bulk-added perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun/bloodletting instruction were not supported by the exact sources reviewed.

location: 下腹部，前正中線上，臍中下2.5寸。雲端中醫表述為神闕（CV8）至曲骨（CV2）連線的中點；既有卡片另以關元（CV4，臍下3寸）與石門（CV5，臍下2寸）的中點作交叉定位。兩種表述均指向前正中線臍下2.5寸，但後者仍標記為既有定位說明。
locationEn: On the lower abdomen, on the anterior midline, 2.5 cun inferior to the umbilicus. CloudTCM describes it as the midpoint of the line from Shenque (CV8) to Qugu (CV2). The legacy card additionally cross-locates it midway between Guanyuan (CV4, 3 cun below the umbilicus) and Shimen (CV5, 2 cun below); both descriptions point to the 2.5-cun midline level, while the latter remains labeled as legacy wording.
cunMeasurement: 前正中線，臍中下2.5寸；雲端中醫以神闕（CV8）至曲骨（CV2）連線中點表述。既有卡片的關元（CV4）與石門（CV5）中點說明予以保留，但本輪未取得其具名課本頁碼。
anatomyZh: 穴位在下腹部前正中線體表。雲端中醫僅概述深部鄰近膀胱與小腸，沒有提供皮膚、皮下組織、腹白線／腹直肌鞘、腹膜與臟器的逐層解剖，也沒有依膀胱充盈度或不同體型調整的安全邊界。此解剖缺口不可用來源所列1～1.5寸刺深自行補齊。
anatomyEn: The point lies on the lower anterior abdominal midline. CloudTCM only gives a general statement that the bladder and small intestine are nearby at depth; it does not provide layered skin, subcutaneous, linea-alba/rectus-sheath, peritoneal, or visceral anatomy, nor safety boundaries adjusted for bladder filling or body habitus. The listed 1-1.5-cun depth cannot be used to invent those missing anatomical safeguards.
techniqueNotes:
雲端中醫精確利尿穴頁：直刺1～1.5寸，針感可向會陰或下腹部放散；可配合艾灸，但未列灸法與劑量。既有卡片另列直刺0.8～1.2寸與『可灸』，本輪未取得具名課本頁碼。先前批次加入的直刺0.3～0.8寸與點刺出血，未獲 Board、課件、eLotus、American Dragon 或精確 CloudTCM 頁支持，不列為可執行方法。
CloudTCM's exact Liniao page lists perpendicular insertion 1-1.5 cun, with sensation possibly radiating toward the perineum or lower abdomen, and states that moxibustion may be combined without supplying a method or dose. The legacy card separately lists perpendicular insertion 0.8-1.2 cun and 'moxa applicable,' pending an edition/page citation. The previously bulk-added perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun and bloodletting instruction is unsupported by the Board, curriculum, eLotus, American Dragon, or the exact CloudTCM page and is not presented as an executable method.
acumethodZh: 雲端中醫的具名數值為直刺1～1.5寸，並描述酸脹感可向會陰或下腹部放散。因其未提供逐層解剖、膀胱充盈條件、體型調整、進針層確認或停止規則，本卡只記錄來源內容，不把該數值擴寫成完整安全操作方案。舊卡0.8～1.2寸與批次值0.3～0.8寸分開保留於來源差異，不合併成新範圍。
acumethodEn: CloudTCM's named value is perpendicular insertion 1-1.5 cun, with soreness or distention possibly radiating toward the perineum or lower abdomen. Because it supplies no layered anatomy, bladder-filling condition, body-habitus adjustment, layer confirmation, or stopping criteria, the card records the source statement without expanding it into a complete safety protocol. The legacy 0.8-1.2-cun value and the bulk-added 0.3-0.8-cun value remain separate source variants and are not merged into a new range.
moxaZh: 雲端中醫只說可配合艾灸；既有卡片亦寫『可灸』。四個核心來源均未提供本穴灸法類型、壯數／分鐘數、艾條距離、皮膚保護、熱傷害停止規則、療程頻率或孕期灸法條文，因此不補數字。
moxaEn: CloudTCM only states that moxibustion may be combined, and the legacy card likewise says that moxa is applicable. None of the four core source layers supplies a point-specific moxa type, cone/minute dose, stick distance, skin protection, thermal-injury stopping rule, treatment frequency, or pregnancy protocol; no number is added.

exam_importance_en: Liniao is not named in the NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A priority extra-point list and has no dedicated local curriculum entry. Study the 2.5-cun-below-umbilicus midline location, its urinary/lower-jiao and intestinal indication groups, and the need to keep conflicting depths source-labeled.
exam_pearl: 利尿的定位是臍下2.5寸前正中線；CloudTCM 精確頁的直刺1～1.5寸不能與舊卡0.8～1.2寸或批次0.3～0.8寸合併。點刺出血目前沒有精確來源支持。

cautions: 【下腹深部安全缺口】雲端中醫提及深部鄰近膀胱與小腸並列直刺1～1.5寸，但沒有逐層解剖、膀胱充盈條件、體型調整、進針層確認或停止規則；兩項資訊不可自行拼成完整安全方案。【刺深分歧】CloudTCM 1～1.5寸、舊卡0.8～1.2寸、批次0.3～0.8寸須分開，不可平均或擴大；批次點刺出血無精確來源支持。【膀胱】舊卡『針刺前宜排空膀胱』是重要但尚未取得具名頁碼的安全敘述，予以保留並標示未核實，不得因 CloudTCM 未述膀胱狀態而反推可在充盈時操作。【孕期】舊卡『孕婦慎用』保留為未核實舊值；Board、課件、eLotus、AD 與精確 CloudTCM 頁均未提供本穴孕期條文，來源沉默不等於安全許可。【艾灸】只查到『可配合艾灸』，沒有劑量與熱傷害防護細節。
cautionsEn: Lower-abdominal deep-safety gap: CloudTCM mentions the bladder and small intestine nearby at depth and lists perpendicular insertion 1-1.5 cun, but supplies no layered anatomy, bladder-filling condition, body-habitus adjustment, layer confirmation, or stopping criteria. These two statements cannot be combined into an invented complete safety protocol.

Depth discrepancy: CloudTCM's 1-1.5 cun, the legacy card's 0.8-1.2 cun, and the bulk-added 0.3-0.8 cun must remain separate rather than averaged or broadened. No exact source supports the bulk-added bloodletting method.

Bladder: the legacy instruction to empty the bladder before needling is important but still lacks an edition/page citation. It is retained as unverified legacy safety content; CloudTCM's silence about bladder status must not be interpreted as permission to needle with a full bladder.

Pregnancy: the legacy 'use caution in pregnancy' statement is retained as unverified. The Board, curriculum, eLotus, American Dragon, and exact CloudTCM page provide no point-specific pregnancy instruction; source silence is not permission.
Moxa: only a general statement that moxibustion may be combined was found; no dose or thermal-injury safeguards were supplied.
combinePointsZh: 【水腫；雲端中醫】配陰陵泉（SP9）、三陰交（SP6），來源解釋為健脾利濕。【尿瀦留；雲端中醫】配中極（CV3）、膀胱俞（BL28），來源解釋為助膀胱氣化、通利小便。【泄瀉；雲端中醫】配天樞（ST25）、上巨虛（ST37），來源解釋為調理腸腑、止瀉。eLotus 與 AD 均無本穴精確條目，故沒有把其他穴位的配伍移植進來。
combinePointsEn: For edema (CloudTCM), combine with Yinlingquan (SP9) and Sanyinjiao (SP6), explained by the source as strengthening the Spleen and draining Dampness. For urinary retention (CloudTCM), combine with Zhongji (CV3) and Pangguangshu (BL28) to assist Bladder Qi transformation and promote urination. For diarrhea (CloudTCM), combine with Tianshu (ST25) and Shangjuxu (ST37) to regulate the intestines and relieve diarrhea. Because eLotus and American Dragon have no exact Liniao entry, no combination was transferred from a different point.
clinical_pearls: 雲端中醫把利尿的內容分成泌尿、腸道與下焦濕熱三組，較舊卡只有小便不利、尿瀦留、尿路感染與水腫更完整；新增的淋證、血尿、腎炎、腹痛、泄瀉、痢疾與腹脹均保留 CloudTCM 來源標籤。拼音由 Liniu 校正為 Liniao。eLotus 與 American Dragon 目前只能留下索引查無紀錄，等待 Ting 借到具名教材後補 edition/page。
clinical_pearls_en: CloudTCM organizes Liniao into urinary, intestinal, and Lower-Jiao Damp-Heat groups, expanding the legacy card's dysuria, urinary retention, UTI, and edema content. Added Lin syndrome, hematuria, nephritis, abdominal pain, diarrhea, dysentery, and abdominal distention remain explicitly CloudTCM-sourced. The pinyin was corrected from Liniu to Liniao. eLotus and American Dragon currently contribute documented index-level absences only; an edition/page citation can be added if Ting supplies a named textbook.
nameIntroZh: 『利尿』直指其通利小便的主要用途。標準無聲調拼音為 Liniao；CloudTCM 題名為『利尿穴』，並列止瀉、血清、關元上三個別名。
nameIntroEn: Liniao literally describes promoting urination, its principal named use. The standard toneless pinyin is Liniao. CloudTCM titles the entry Liniao Point and lists Zhixie, Xueqing, and Guanyuanshang as aliases.
evidence: 四層查核：NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A 未列 Liniao；curriculum/acupoints 以利尿、利尿穴、Liniu、Liniao、EX-CA5 與 Ex-CA8 搜尋均無專條。eLotus 現行 Traditional Points List 以 Liniao、Liniu 與 Li Niao 搜尋無命中，未找到可核讀專頁。American Dragon 拼音索引以 Liniao 與 Liniu 搜尋無命中，未找到精確 AD 專頁；Tongbian 為另一穴，不移植內容。CloudTCM 精確詞典頁 dic/7681 提供別名、臍下2.5寸前正中線定位、泌尿／腸道／下焦濕熱主治、直刺1～1.5寸與針感方向、可配合艾灸、四項整理性功效及三組配穴。舊卡直刺0.8～1.2寸、排空膀胱與孕期慎用保留為未核實舊值；批次直刺0.3～0.8寸與點刺出血不再列為可執行技法。

needlingEn: CloudTCM's exact page lists perpendicular insertion 1-1.5 cun, with sensation possibly radiating toward the perineum or lower abdomen, and says moxibustion may be combined without a method or dose. The legacy perpendicular 0.8-1.2-cun value remains separately labeled as unverified; the bulk-added 0.3-0.8-cun and bloodletting methods lack exact-source support.

location: 項背交界，第7頸椎棘突下凹陷（大椎 GV14）旁開0.5寸，左右各一穴。eLotus 固定為旁開0.5寸；American Dragon 主列旁開0.5～1寸，另兩條來源表述為旁開0.5寸，故本卡以0.5寸作共同核心，保留 AD 的1寸上限為來源變體。
locationEn: At the cervicothoracic junction, bilateral, 0.5 cun lateral to the depression below the C7 spinous process at Dazhui (GV14). eLotus fixes the location at 0.5 cun lateral. American Dragon's first statement gives 0.5-1 cun, while its other two statements give 0.5 cun; this card retains 0.5 cun as the shared core and labels AD's 1-cun upper limit as a source variant.
cunMeasurement: 先以頸椎伸展時仍保持突出作為 C7 棘突的臨床辨認線索，再取其棘突下大椎（GV14）水平旁開0.5寸。AD 另列0.5～1寸變體；不可把1寸無條件併入 eLotus 的固定0.5寸定位。
anatomyZh: 穴位位於 C7 棘突下、後正中線旁開的項背交界區。四個核心內容層均未提供本穴皮膚、皮下組織、斜方肌／深層頸背肌、骨性屏障、胸膜頂與椎管的逐層距離。2006 年屍體解剖研究將定喘列入胸膜頂周圍觀察穴，指出依標準定位與方向進針仍須遵守深度界限，但摘要沒有提供定喘專屬安全深度；CCAOM 潔針手冊則記錄中文文獻中定喘曾少見發生氣胸。兩者不能被簡化成『一定安全』或一個通用深度。
anatomyEn: The point is at the cervicothoracic junction, lateral to the posterior midline below the C7 spinous process. None of the four core content layers supplies point-specific layer-by-layer distances through skin, subcutaneous tissue, trapezius/deep cervicothoracic muscles, bony barriers, pleural cupula, or spinal canal. A 2006 cadaveric study examined Dingchuan among points around the pleural cupula and warned that standard location/direction still requires a depth limit, but its abstract gives no Dingchuan-specific safe depth. The CCAOM Clean Needle Technique manual separately reports infrequent pneumothorax events at Dingchuan in Chinese literature. These findings cannot be reduced to either 'always safe' or one universal depth.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus：直刺0.5～0.8寸，可灸。American Dragon：①朝脊柱方向直斜刺0.5～1寸；②直刺0.5～0.8寸；③直刺但針尖略向脊柱0.5～1寸，局部酸脹可延至肩或胸；可灸。現行卡片的『直刺0.5～1寸，或向脊柱方向斜刺0.5～1寸』涵蓋 AD 變體，但不可冒充 eLotus 共識。
eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.5-0.8 cun; moxibustion applicable. American Dragon: (1) perpendicular-oblique insertion toward the spine, 0.5-1 cun; (2) perpendicular insertion 0.5-0.8 cun; and (3) straight insertion pointed slightly toward the spine, 0.5-1 cun, with local distention/soreness sometimes extending to the shoulders or chest; moxibustion applicable. The current card's perpendicular 0.5-1-cun or spine-directed oblique 0.5-1-cun wording covers the AD variants but must not be presented as eLotus consensus.
acumethodZh: 來源共同支持直刺0.5～0.8寸；AD 另列朝脊柱方向直斜刺／略向脊柱0.5～1寸。方向與深度必須整組保留：AD 的1寸上限只出現在朝脊柱的表述中，不可轉成向外側或任意方向深刺。四源均未提供骨性接觸、進針層確認、體型調整或椎管側停止規則。
acumethodEn: The exact pages share perpendicular insertion 0.5-0.8 cun. American Dragon additionally lists perpendicular-oblique or straight insertion slightly toward the spine, 0.5-1 cun. Direction and depth must remain paired: AD's 1-cun upper limit appears with a spine-directed route and cannot be converted into deep lateral or unrestricted insertion. The four core layers provide no bony-contact, tissue-layer confirmation, body-habitus adjustment, or spinal-canal-side stopping criteria.
moxaZh: eLotus 與 American Dragon 均只寫『可灸』，沒有提供灸法種類、壯數／分鐘數、艾條距離、皮膚保護、項背毛髮／衣物防火、熱傷害停止規則、療程頻率或特殊族群條文，因此不補劑量。
moxaEn: Both eLotus and American Dragon only state that moxibustion is applicable. Neither supplies a moxa type, cone/minute dose, stick distance, skin protection, fire precautions for hair/clothing at the cervicothoracic junction, thermal-injury stopping rule, treatment frequency, or special-population protocol; no dose is added.

exam_importance_en: Dingchuan is named in the NCBAHM 2026 Appendix A. Board-focused recall: 0.5 cun lateral to GV14 below C7, diffusion of Lung Qi with calming wheezing/cough, and the distinction between shared perpendicular 0.5-0.8 cun and AD's spine-directed 0.5-1-cun variant. Cervicothoracic/pleural safety cannot be reduced to memorizing a number.
exam_pearl: 『定喘』即以平喘為名：哮喘、喘鳴、咳嗽是兩個精確頁的最穩定核心。AD 的1寸只隨朝脊柱方向出現；CCAOM 又記錄定喘少見氣胸事件，因此不可把1寸轉成向外深刺。
exam_pearl_en: The name Dingchuan directly signals calming wheezing: asthma, wheezing, and cough are the stable core across both exact pages. AD's 1-cun value appears only with a spine-directed route, while the CCAOM manual reports infrequent pneumothorax events at Dingchuan; it must never be converted into deep lateral insertion.

Unblock the Channels and Relieve Pain
cautions: 【方向與深度綁定】共同值為直刺0.5～0.8寸；AD 的0.5～1寸只隨朝脊柱／略向脊柱方向出現。不可將1寸上限改讀為向外側、朝胸廓或任意方向深刺。【氣胸證據不能相消】CCAOM 潔針手冊記錄中文文獻中定喘曾少見發生氣胸；2006屍體研究則指出胸膜頂周圍穴即使按標準定位方向操作，超過界限仍可破壞胸膜，但摘要未給定喘專屬安全深度。不得據其中任何一項宣稱本穴沒有氣胸風險或製造通用深度。【解剖缺口】精確頁未列逐層組織、胸膜頂／椎管距離、不同體型、骨性接觸、針具長度或停止規則。【術後警訊；CCAOM】針後立即或延遲出現呼吸困難／呼吸急促、胸痛、乾咳、發紺或出汗，屬氣胸警訊；手冊要求懷疑臟器穿刺時啟動急救轉送。【高風險因素；CCAOM】肺病、吸菸史、很高瘦、萎縮或肌量流失會縮短表面至肺的距離，必須在操作前評估。【艾灸／特殊族群缺口】兩頁僅稱可灸；四源沒有本穴孕期、兒童或其他特殊族群的點特異操作條文，來源沉默不等於安全許可。
cautionsEn: Direction and depth are inseparable: the shared value is perpendicular 0.5-0.8 cun. AD's 0.5-1-cun value appears only with a toward-the-spine or slightly spine-directed route. The 1-cun upper limit must not be reinterpreted as deep lateral, thorax-directed, or unrestricted insertion.

Pneumothorax evidence cannot cancel itself out: the CCAOM Clean Needle Technique manual reports infrequent pneumothorax events at Dingchuan in Chinese literature. A 2006 cadaveric study of points around the pleural cupula states that exceeding the limit despite standard location/direction can injure pleura, but its abstract gives no Dingchuan-specific safe depth. Neither finding supports declaring the point risk-free or inventing a universal depth.
Anatomy gap: the exact pages provide no layered tissues, pleural-cupula/spinal-canal distances, body-habitus adjustments, bony-contact guidance, needle-length rule, or stopping criteria.

Post-needling warning signs (CCAOM): immediate or delayed dyspnea/tachypnea, chest pain, dry cough, cyanosis, or sweating may indicate pneumothorax; the manual calls for emergency transport when organ puncture is suspected.
Higher-risk factors (CCAOM): lung disease, smoking history, very tall/thin physique, atrophy, or muscle loss can shorten the surface-to-lung distance and require pre-procedure assessment.

Moxa/special-population gap: both pages only say moxa is applicable. The four layers provide no point-specific pregnancy, pediatric, or other special-population protocol; source silence is not permission.
combinePointsZh: American Dragon 配穴表列四組：① 天突（CV22）配孔最（LU6）治急性哮喘；② 天突（CV22）、大椎（GV14）、豐隆（ST40）治百日咳；③ 風門（BL12）、肺俞（BL13）、合谷（LI4）治支氣管炎；④ 天突（CV22）、璇璣（CV21）、膻中（CV17）、內關（PC6）、豐隆（ST40）治支氣管哮喘。表格欄列已從原始 HTML 逐列核對；eLotus 頁未列配穴。
combinePointsEn: American Dragon lists four groups: (1) Tiantu (CV22) with Kongzui (LU6) for acute asthma; (2) Tiantu (CV22), Dazhui (GV14), and Fenglong (ST40) for pertussis; (3) Fengmen (BL12), Feishu (BL13), and Hegu (LI4) for bronchitis; and (4) Tiantu (CV22), Xuanji (CV21), Shanzhong (CV17), Neiguan (PC6), and Fenglong (ST40) for bronchial asthma. The row/column alignment was checked against the page's raw HTML; the eLotus page lists no combinations.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 提供最精簡核心：旁開0.5寸、喘咳與頸肩背痛／風疹、直刺0.5～0.8寸及可灸。AD 補入 M-BW-1 身分、0.5～1寸定位變體、朝脊柱刺法與針感、祛外風、蕁麻疹／百日咳／支氣管炎、四組配穴及『現代新增穴』說明。既有『化痰、通絡止痛』保留，但分別標作未明列功效與主治衍生功效。
clinical_pearls_en: eLotus supplies the concise core: 0.5 cun lateral, dyspnea/wheezing/cough plus neck-shoulder-back pain and rubella, perpendicular 0.5-0.8 cun, and moxa applicable. AD adds the M-BW-1 identity, a 0.5-1-cun location variant, spine-directed techniques and sensation, expelling Exterior Wind, urticaria/pertussis/bronchitis, four combination groups, and the note that this is a modern addition. Legacy 'transform phlegm' and 'unblock channels/relieve pain' are retained but labeled respectively as not explicitly listed and indication-derived.
nameIntroZh: 『定喘』意為穩定喘息。eLotus 英譯 Dyspnea Stabilizer、Calm Dyspnea、Stop Wheezing；AD 英譯 Calm Dyspnea，另列 Stopping Asthma、Stop Wheezing，均直接指向本穴的呼吸主治。
nameIntroEn: Dingchuan means stabilizing or calming wheezing/dyspnea. eLotus translates it as Dyspnea Stabilizer, Calm Dyspnea, and Stop Wheezing; AD uses Calm Dyspnea with Stopping Asthma and Stop Wheezing, all directly reflecting the respiratory indication core.
evidence: 四層查核：NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A 明列 Dingchuan，屬 Board 優先穴；curriculum/acupoints 以定喘、Dingchuan、EX-B1、Ex-B1 搜尋無專條。eLotus 精確 Ex-B1 頁提供旁開GV14 0.5寸、喘咳哮喘、頸強肩背痛、風疹、直刺0.5～0.8寸與可灸。American Dragon 拼音索引可連至 M-BW-1 精確頁，提供0.5～1寸定位變體、三種刺法表述與針感、五項功效、蕁麻疹／支氣管炎／百日咳等主治、四組配穴、別名及現代新增穴說明；禁忌欄空白不視為安全證明。補充安全層：CCAOM 潔針手冊列定喘為中文文獻中少見氣胸事件穴，並提供胸背針刺風險因素與警訊；2006屍體研究指出胸膜頂周圍穴超出標準定位方向的深度界限可損傷胸膜，但摘要未提供定喘專屬數字。CloudTCM 未找到可核讀定喘專頁，不以其他穴提及定喘的文字代替本穴內容。

needling: 共同刺法為直刺0.5～0.8寸。American Dragon 另列朝脊柱方向直斜刺／針尖略向脊柱0.5～1寸，局部酸脹可延至肩或胸。1寸上限不可改讀為向外側或任意方向深刺；來源未提供定喘專屬逐層安全深度。
needlingEn: The shared method is perpendicular insertion 0.5-0.8 cun. American Dragon additionally lists perpendicular-oblique or straight insertion slightly toward the spine, 0.5-1 cun, with local soreness/distention possibly extending to the shoulder or chest. The 1-cun upper limit must not be reinterpreted as deep lateral or unrestricted insertion; no source supplies a Dingchuan-specific layer-based safe depth.

location: 經典組位於背腰部，第1胸椎至第5腰椎各棘突下緣旁開0.5寸，左右各17穴，共34穴。課件與 eLotus 均固定旁開0.5寸；American Dragon 主列旁開0.5～1寸，並另述臨床可延伸至 C1～C7。頸椎延伸不計入 EX-B2 經典34穴。
locationEn: The classical set consists of 17 bilateral pairs (34 points), 0.5 cun lateral to the lower border of each spinous process from T1 through L5. The curriculum and eLotus fix the lateral distance at 0.5 cun. American Dragon gives 0.5-1 cun and also describes a clinical extension from C1 through C7; that cervical extension is not part of the classical 34-point EX-B2 set.
cunMeasurement: 先逐節確認 T1～L5 棘突及其下緣，再於同一水平向旁開0.5寸取穴；共17個椎體水平、左右成對。AD 的0.5～1寸與頸椎 C1～C7 屬來源變體，不可無標示併入課件／eLotus 的經典定位。
anatomyZh: 此為跨越胸椎與腰椎的系列穴，不能用一個深度代表全部節段。四個核心內容層未提供各椎體水平的皮膚、皮下、豎脊肌／多裂肌、椎板、肋骨、胸膜、椎間孔或椎管距離。2024年華佗夾脊針刺後血氣胸病例證明胸段可發生危及生命的胸膜／肺部併發症；胸部CT研究亦顯示皮膚至肺距離受解剖水平、BMI、年齡與體位影響，研究者主張以『危險深度』取代單一『安全深度』概念。該CT研究不是 EX-B2 專穴測量，僅作區域風險證據。
anatomyEn: This is a multilevel series spanning thoracic and lumbar regions; one depth cannot represent every segment. The four core content layers do not provide level-specific distances through skin, subcutaneous tissue, erector spinae/multifidus, lamina, ribs, pleura, intervertebral foramina, or spinal canal. A 2024 case report documents life-threatening hemopneumothorax after thoracic Huatuo-Jiaji needling. A thoracic CT study also found that skin-to-lung distance varies with anatomical level, BMI, age, and positioning, and recommended replacing a single 'safe depth' concept with individualized 'dangerous depth.' That CT study was regional rather than EX-B2-specific and is used only as supporting safety evidence.
techniqueNotes:
課件：直刺或略向脊柱斜刺；胸段0.5～1.0寸，腰段1～2寸，另列皮下刺2～3寸；頁面另有括號／紅字數值但層級關係不清，本卡不自行解讀。eLotus：胸段直刺0.5～1.0寸，腰段直刺1.0～1.5寸，可灸。AD：常規表述包括略向脊柱直斜刺0.5～1寸，以及頸胸0.5～1寸、腰段1～1.5寸；另列達神經根或棘間韌帶方向的較深技法，因缺少影像、逐層確認、體型調整與停止規則，只保留為進階來源記錄，不納入一般可執行刺法。
Curriculum: perpendicular or slightly oblique toward the spine; thoracic 0.5-1.0 cun, lumbar 1-2 cun, and a separate subcutaneous method of 2-3 cun. Additional bracketed/red values on the page have unclear hierarchy and are not interpreted here. eLotus: perpendicular thoracic 0.5-1.0 cun and lumbar 1.0-1.5 cun; moxibustion applicable. AD includes routine spine-directed 0.5-1-cun wording and cervical/thoracic 0.5-1 cun with lumbar 1-1.5 cun. Its deeper nerve-root and interspinous-ligament approaches lack imaging, layer confirmation, body-habitus adjustment, and stopping rules, so they are retained only as advanced source records and not as generally executable instructions.
acumethodZh: 一般資料層以課件與 eLotus 的分區值呈現：胸段直刺0.5～1.0寸；腰段 eLotus 為1.0～1.5寸、課件另列1～2寸；可略向脊柱斜刺。課件另列皮下刺2～3寸。AD 的較深神經根／韌帶技法不得從來源文字直接轉成一般操作；任何方向、深度與節段必須成組保存。
acumethodEn: The general data layer follows the curriculum/eLotus regional values: thoracic perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun; lumbar 1.0-1.5 cun in eLotus, with the curriculum separately listing 1-2 cun; a slight oblique direction toward the spine may be used. The curriculum also lists subcutaneous insertion 2-3 cun. AD's deeper nerve-root/ligament techniques are not converted directly into general instructions. Segment, direction, and depth must remain linked.
moxaZh: eLotus 與 American Dragon 均只註明可灸，未提供灸法種類、壯數／分鐘數、艾條距離、脊旁皮膚保護、療程頻率、熱傷害停止規則或特殊族群條文；課件頁亦未給灸量，因此不補劑量。
moxaEn: eLotus and American Dragon only state that moxibustion is applicable. They provide no moxa type, cone/minute dose, stick distance, paraspinal skin protection, treatment frequency, thermal-injury stopping rule, or special-population protocol; the curriculum page also gives no moxa dose, so none is added.

cautions: 【分區刺法】胸段與腰段必須分開：課件／eLotus 胸段0.5～1.0寸；eLotus 腰段1.0～1.5寸，課件另列1～2寸。不可把腰段上限套到胸段。【胸膜風險】2024年病例報告記錄胸段華佗夾脊針刺後危及生命的血氣胸；不可只以『靠近脊柱』或單一寸數宣稱安全。【個體差異】胸部CT研究顯示皮膚至肺距離隨解剖水平、BMI、年齡與體位改變，且最短測值僅0.9 cm；該數字不是 EX-B2 的處方深度，而是反對固定通用安全深度的區域證據。【AD進階技法】AD 所列達神經根或棘間韌帶的較深刺法缺少影像定位、各節段解剖邊界、骨性接觸、體型調整、針長與停止規則，不納入一般可執行方案。【術後警訊】胸段針刺後若出現胸痛、呼吸困難、乾咳、心搏加速、發紺、頭暈或症狀延遲出現，須立即按疑似胸膜／肺損傷轉送評估；不能因初期症狀輕微而排除。【來源缺口】四源未提供本穴孕期、兒童、抗凝／出血風險、脊柱術後、感染、嚴重骨質疏鬆或其他高風險族群的點特異方案；來源沉默不等於安全許可。
cautionsEn: Regional technique must remain separate: the curriculum/eLotus give thoracic 0.5-1.0 cun; eLotus gives lumbar 1.0-1.5 cun, while the curriculum separately lists 1-2 cun. A lumbar upper limit must never be transferred to the thoracic region.
Pleural risk: a 2024 case report documents life-threatening hemopneumothorax after thoracic Huatuo-Jiaji acupuncture. Neither proximity to the spine nor a single cun value proves safety.

Individual variation: a thoracic CT study found that skin-to-lung distance changes with anatomical level, BMI, age, and positioning, with a shortest measured distance of 0.9 cm. That value is not an EX-B2 prescription depth; it is regional evidence against a fixed universal safe depth.

AD advanced techniques: deeper nerve-root or interspinous-ligament approaches lack imaging guidance, level-specific anatomical boundaries, bony-contact rules, body-habitus adjustment, needle-length selection, and stopping criteria, so they are not included as generally executable instructions.

Post-needling warning signs: chest pain, dyspnea, dry cough, tachycardia, cyanosis, dizziness, or delayed symptoms after thoracic needling require urgent evaluation for pleural/lung injury; mild early symptoms do not exclude it.

Source gap: the four layers provide no point-specific protocol for pregnancy, children, anticoagulation/bleeding risk, prior spinal surgery, infection, severe osteoporosis, or other high-risk groups. Source silence is not permission.
combinePointsZh: eLotus 與 American Dragon 精確頁均未列固定配穴。兩頁以『按受累椎體／神經節段選取相應夾脊穴』作臨床選穴框架；這是節段選穴，不是配穴組合。課件另列帶狀疱疹取受累神經節段。
combinePointsEn: Neither the eLotus nor American Dragon exact page lists fixed point combinations. Both frame treatment by selecting Jiaji points at the involved vertebral/nerve segment; this is segmental point selection, not a combination prescription. The curriculum likewise specifies the affected nerve segment for herpes zoster.
clinical_pearls: 四源共同核心是 T1～L5 的34穴與調和五臟六腑。課件節段表為 T1～T3 肺／上肢、T4～T6 心、T7～T9 肝膽、T10～T12 脾胃、L1～L2 腎、L3～L5 膀胱／大小腸／子宮／下肢；eLotus／AD 則為 T1～T4 肺／上肢、T4～T7 心／胸、T7～T10 肝膽／腹、T10～T12 脾胃／腹，腰段相近。兩套分界重疊且不同，卡片並列保存，不製造假共識。AD 另補頸椎延伸、較廣區域對應與進階刺法；均標為來源變體。
clinical_pearls_en: The shared core is the 34-point T1-L5 set and regulation of the Five Zang and Six Fu. The curriculum maps T1-T3 to Lung/upper limbs, T4-T6 to Heart, T7-T9 to Liver/Gallbladder, T10-T12 to Spleen/Stomach, L1-L2 to Kidney, and L3-L5 to Bladder/intestines/uterus/lower limbs. eLotus/AD instead use T1-T4 for Lung/upper limbs, T4-T7 for Heart/chest, T7-T10 for Liver/Gallbladder/abdomen, and T10-T12 for Spleen/Stomach/abdomen, with similar lumbar mappings. Because boundaries overlap and differ, both tables are retained rather than presented as false consensus. AD's cervical extension, broader regional mapping, and advanced techniques remain source-labeled variants.
nameIntroZh: 華佗夾脊又稱夾脊。課件使用 M-BW-35，英名列 Hua Tuo's Paravertebral Points 及 Hair Clip；eLotus 另列 Hua Tuo's Back Filling Points；AD 另列 Hua Tuo Bilateral Spinal Points。各英名保留為來源別名，不改動主名 Huatuojiaji。
nameIntroEn: Huatuojiaji is also called Jiaji. The curriculum uses M-BW-35 and lists Hua Tuo's Paravertebral Points and Hair Clip. eLotus additionally gives Hua Tuo's Back Filling Points, while AD lists Hua Tuo Bilateral Spinal Points. These are retained as source-specific aliases without changing the primary name Huatuojiaji.
evidence: 四層查核：NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A 明列 Huatuojiaji；curriculum/acupoints/Techniques 3 points.pdf p.6 提供 M-BW-35 身分、T1～L5旁開0.5寸34穴、胸／腰／皮下刺法、調和五臟六腑與節段主治，Quizzes.md 再確認17對34穴。eLotus Ex-B2 精確頁提供相同核心定位、胸腰分區刺深、可灸及其節段表。American Dragon 拼音索引與 M-BW-35 精確頁提供定位變體、頸椎臨床延伸、多種刺法、臟腑／區域節段表、別名與歷史說明；禁忌欄無內容，不視為安全證明。補充安全層採2024華佗夾脊血氣胸病例與胸部CT危險深度研究；後者不是本穴專屬測量。CloudTCM 未找到可核讀的華佗夾脊專頁。

needling: 胸段直刺0.5～1.0寸；腰段依 eLotus 直刺1.0～1.5寸，課件另列1～2寸；亦可略向脊柱斜刺。課件另列皮下刺2～3寸。AD 的深達神經根／韌帶技法因缺少安全執行條件，只作進階來源記錄，不納入一般方案。
needlingEn: Thoracic perpendicular insertion 0.5-1.0 cun; lumbar perpendicular insertion 1.0-1.5 cun in eLotus, with the curriculum separately listing 1-2 cun; a slight oblique direction toward the spine may also be used. The curriculum separately lists subcutaneous insertion 2-3 cun. AD's deeper nerve-root/ligament methods lack sufficient execution safeguards and remain advanced source notes rather than general instructions.

location: 背部，第8胸椎（T8）棘突下緣水平，後正中線旁開1.5寸，左右各一穴。American Dragon 補充可取豎脊肌肉眼可見最高處作旁開定位參考；此觸診提示不能取代 T8 棘突與1.5寸量取。
locationEn: On the back, bilateral, 1.5 cun lateral to the posterior midline at the level of the lower border of the T8 spinous process. American Dragon adds the visible highest point of the paraspinal muscle as a locating reference; this palpatory cue does not replace identifying T8 and measuring 1.5 cun.
cunMeasurement: 先定位 T8 棘突下緣水平，再自後正中線量取1.5寸，左右成對。國家標準／研究文獻使用胃脘下俞 EX-B3；eLotus 頁面顯示胃管下俞 Ex-B3；AD 以胰俞 Yishu、M-BW-12 收錄，均屬命名／代碼來源差異，不改動本庫永久 `EX-B3`。
anatomyZh: 2014年專穴綜述記載局部由淺入深為皮膚、皮下組織、斜方肌、背闊肌、豎脊肌；淺層有 T8 脊神經後支皮支及伴行血管，深層有 T8 後支肌支與第8肋間後動靜脈的背側分支／後支。該文引用屍體研究，左右側與性別的危險點深度不同，並列另一研究的平均安全深度21.54 mm、危險深度30.77 mm。這些是固定屍體／文獻數據，不是對每位患者的通用進針處方；胸膜與肺仍是本穴最重要深部風險。
anatomyEn: A 2014 point-specific review describes the local layers as skin, subcutaneous tissue, trapezius, latissimus dorsi, and erector spinae. Superficially it reports the cutaneous branch of the T8 posterior ramus with accompanying vessels; deeper structures include the muscular branch of the T8 posterior ramus and dorsal/posterior branches of the eighth posterior intercostal vessels. The review cites cadaver data showing side- and sex-related differences in dangerous depth and a separate study reporting mean safe and dangerous depths of 21.54 mm and 30.77 mm. These fixed-cadaver/literature measurements are not universal patient prescriptions; pleura and lung remain the principal deep risks.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus：斜刺0.5～0.7寸，未註明方向，可灸。American Dragon：向脊柱斜刺0.5～1寸；另列橫向斜刺1～1.5寸，並明確警告直刺或向外斜刺有顯著氣胸風險。2020糖尿病周邊神經病變試驗方案依 WHO 定位，採向內斜刺0.5～0.8寸；這是研究方案，不是療效證明。2014專穴綜述建議向脊柱45°～60°斜刺1～1.5寸；若直刺則不超過20 mm，但此點與 AD『直刺有顯著風險』衝突。本卡一般可執行層採共同較保守的向脊柱斜刺0.5～0.7寸；其餘分列為來源變體。舊卡『直刺0.5～1寸』缺具名來源且與 AD 警示衝突，僅留作已校正歷史值。
eLotus: oblique 0.5-0.7 cun, direction unspecified; moxibustion applicable. American Dragon: oblique toward the spine 0.5-1 cun and a separate transverse-oblique 1-1.5-cun method, with explicit warning that perpendicular or outward-oblique insertion carries substantial pneumothorax risk. A 2020 diabetic peripheral-neuropathy trial protocol used WHO location and medial-oblique 0.5-0.8 cun; it is a study protocol, not efficacy proof. A 2014 point-specific review recommends 45-60° medial-oblique insertion 1-1.5 cun and limits perpendicular insertion to 20 mm, which conflicts with AD's warning against perpendicular needling. The general executable layer therefore uses the shared, more conservative medial-oblique 0.5-0.7 cun; other values remain source-specific variants. The legacy perpendicular 0.5-1-cun instruction lacks a named source and conflicts with AD, so it is retained only as corrected history.
acumethodZh: 一般層：針尖向脊柱斜刺0.5～0.7寸。eLotus 未寫方向，故『向脊柱』來自 AD 與研究安全層；不能把 AD 的1寸上限或橫向斜刺1～1.5寸無條件併入 eLotus。2014文獻的45°～60°、1～1.5寸與直刺不超過20 mm屬文獻建議，且與 AD 直刺警告有衝突，臨床不可忽略個體胸壁厚度。
acumethodEn: General layer: oblique insertion toward the spine, 0.5-0.7 cun. eLotus does not specify direction, so 'toward the spine' comes from AD and the supplemental safety literature. AD's 1-cun upper value or transverse-oblique 1-1.5-cun method cannot be silently merged into eLotus. The 2014 literature recommendation of 45-60° medial-oblique 1-1.5 cun and perpendicular no more than 20 mm is source-specific and conflicts with AD's perpendicular warning; individual thoracic-wall thickness cannot be ignored.
moxaZh: eLotus 只寫可灸，未給灸法或劑量。AD 配穴表的原始 HTML 第一欄寫『第8胸椎棘突下之穴（100壯）』，但沒有旁開1.5寸、穴名或代碼，不能確認就是胰俞本穴；2014綜述引述古籍亦見100壯歷史灸法。兩者都缺現代艾灸種類、皮膚保護、分次、熱傷害停止規則與特殊族群條文，故不把100壯轉成現代可執行劑量。
moxaEn: eLotus only says moxibustion is applicable and gives no method or dose. In AD's raw combination-table HTML, the first column says 'the point found inferior to the spinous process of the eighth thoracic vertebra (100 moxa cones)' but supplies no 1.5-cun lateral distance, point name, or code, so it cannot be confirmed as Yishu itself. The 2014 review also quotes a historical 100-cone method. Neither source supplies a modern moxa type, skin protection, fractionation, thermal-injury stopping rule, or special-population protocol; 100 cones is not converted into an executable contemporary dose.

exam_importance: 本穴未列 NCBAHM Appendix A 具名清單。學習核心：T8 棘突下旁開1.5寸、EX-B3；清熱生津，主消渴／咽乾及胃脘、胸脅疼痛與嘔吐；胸段必須向脊柱斜刺並防氣胸。
exam_importance_en: This point is not named in NCBAHM Appendix A. Study core: EX-B3, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of T8; clears Heat and generates fluids for wasting-thirst/dry throat plus epigastric, chest/hypochondriac pain and vomiting; thoracic insertion is directed medially with pneumothorax precautions.
exam_pearl: 『胃脘下俞』先記 T8、旁開1.5寸、消渴；AD 要用別名 Yishu 才能找到。不要把胰俞的經驗主治寫成『可取代糖尿病治療』，也不要把歷史100壯當現代標準灸量。
exam_pearl_en: For Weiwanxiashu, remember T8, 1.5 cun lateral, and wasting-thirst. American Dragon is found under the alias Yishu. Do not turn its empirical diabetes indication into a replacement for diabetes care, or a historical 100-cone statement into a modern standard dose.
